deadline_text: Rolling. Applications are held for one year. The summer 2026 program was full, so summer applications were closed when read.

what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: Rolling. Applications are held for one year. The summer form said summer applications were not being accepted because of high demand and limited space.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for at least six months. You help patients, visitors and staff. After an interview, you get a role that fits you.
deadline_text: Rolling. Applications are held for one year. The form cannot be saved, so finish it in one sitting (30 minutes).

what_you_do: Help patients and visitors in the hospital. You might be a greeter or work in the gift shop. Other departments need help too. Roles differ by location.
deadline_text: Rolling. Applications are held for one year. The summer form said new applications were not being accepted because of high demand and limited space.

what_you_do: Plan teen programs, keep the teen area welcoming, suggest books for the teen collection, and speak up for teens. The group meets monthly.
deadline_text: The library is accepting new members for the 2026-2027 school year. No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: Help in library departments with tasks like shelving. Teens can also earn community service hours by writing book reviews on the Review Crew.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Be a teen ambassador for the art center. Plan and lead 2 to 3 community art events. Meet artists who work today. Earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: The page says "APPLICATIONS ARE CURRENTLY OPEN!" but gives no closing date. Its board photo is captioned 2023-24.

what_you_do: Job shadow and do a paid summer internship in health care. You can also earn a credential at Oakton Community College. You may qualify for an ASPIRE scholarship.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: Join career mentorships, internships, job shadowing, practicums and service learning set up by the school. Internships can be paid or unpaid and last from a few weeks to a year.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Contact the Early College and Career Experiences office.

what_you_do: Work up to nine weeks in an entry level summer job with a city department, a community group or a business. A job fair is where youth meet employers.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: youth had to register ahead for the job fair on Saturday, February 28, 2026 (9 a.m. to 2 p.m., Robert Crown Community Center). 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: You can take free college classes while in high school. You can pick open classes (up to 11 units, 7 in summer), or take a set of college classes taught at a partner high school (up to 15 units a semester).
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.

what_you_do: You get a summer internship at one of 66 host sites in Southern California. The sites are companies and community groups. The Port of Los Angeles offers a two- to six-week EXP summer internship.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. EXP says to email internship@expfuture.org.

what_you_do: You can join career exploration posts in 12 fields. Fields include health care, law enforcement, fire, engineering, and law and government. The posts include hands-on activities.
deadline_text: Rolling.

what_you_do: Local high school students work on research in a lab. The work is computational and wet-lab. It happens after school and in summer.
deadline_text: No application process or dates posted.

what_you_do: Summer internship with the county IT department. The county page gives no task list.
deadline_text: Recruitment generally starts in April. No 2027 dates posted.

what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a county Rec Center pool. The Park Authority pays for your lifeguard license, CPR and First Aid course, then you guard and help with site operations.
deadline_text: Open positions posted on the page; no deadline stated. Training dates are shared at the interview.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a Fairfax County library branch. You gain skills and experience. You can meet service requirements. Each branch has its own volunteer coordinator.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Monthly sessions on local government. Then a three-week full-time internship in July in a Fairfax County department. Students also meet a member of the Board of Supervisors.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027-2028 class are due 11:59 p.m. Sunday, Nov 8, 2026. Decisions emailed in mid-December.

what_you_do: Do workshops on getting ready for work, then a paid six week work experience matched to your interests. Common jobs listed include administrative assistant, social media assistant, tech intern, animal caretaker, research assistant and counselor-in-training.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ended with a recognition ceremony on Aug 14, 2026. The county says employer recruitment for the next summer begins in spring 2027. Youth sign-up dates for 2027 are not posted.

what_you_do: A free week-long camp. You learn the basics of machine learning with hands-on projects. You build simple tech prototypes. You also share your own ideas in teams.
deadline_text: 2026 application closed because spots filled; applicants were told their week starting the week of June 8, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Each day has a short lesson, a hands-on activity and a team build session. The session is called the AI Maker Lab. You work on real health problems. The week ends with a showcase and a certificate of completion.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 27 to 31, 2026 and applications are closed. No 2027 dates are posted. The page offers a Future Programs Interest Form.

what_you_do: A four-day overnight summit on campus. It has role plays, workshops and talks on world conflict, fairness and making peace. There is a trip to DC museums. You can add 1 college credit.
deadline_text: Page says applications for 2027 open in January (2027) and the summit is in Summer 2027, July 25 to 29. Closing date not posted.

what_you_do: Do your own health research project with a PhD student mentor, in evening sessions 2 to 3 times a month, then present at the HSMP Colloquium. Fully virtual, no wet lab.
deadline_text: Applications open for the 2027 spring cohort. Deadline Dec 20, 2026; accepted until full.

what_you_do: Weekend and summer classes in game design with Unity, Python game programming, and 2D game art. Students build games and art projects.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 teen classes are closed. No deadline listed; classes cancel with a full refund if too few sign up. Summer 2026 registration closed, 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Spend three days at Mason's Fairfax campus. You go to university lectures and do hands-on STEM challenges. Teams work on a research project. It is about a global STEM or sustainability challenge. You also explore STEM careers.
deadline_text: The 2027 program is tentatively July 28 to 30, 2027, with final dates confirmed in January 2027. The application opens in February 2027. No deadline is posted yet.

what_you_do: A week-long conference where you live on campus. You learn by doing with working journalists, world news outlets and Washington insiders. Students live in GMU dorms and earn general elective credit.
deadline_text: 2027 session dates are listed. The page shows a scholarship deadline of Feb 16, 2026 (looks left over from last cycle). No general deadline posted.

what_you_do: A week-long program where you live on campus. You visit sites, hear talks and learn by doing with leaders in the environment, experts in conservation and researchers. Students live in GMU dorms and can earn general science credit.
deadline_text: 2027 dates are listed (June 27 to July 2, 2027). No application deadline or cost is posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: Volunteer at county community centers, teen centers and youth programs. You build ties in your town and earn service hours. Jobs are posted in the county volunteer portal.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

what_you_do: A six-week summer program. You earn college credit in Intro to Data Center Operations and College Success Skills. You learn from industry leaders. You also visit a local site.
deadline_text: 2026: applications opened March 10 and closed May 1, 2026 (lottery selection). 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Help staff at summer Rec-PAC school sites, RECenters, parks and camps run by the Park Authority.
deadline_text: FAQ says Rec-PAC applications were due June 14 (page does not give a year). Rec Center sites: contact the site to set an interview.

what_you_do: Explore law enforcement careers for women. You learn about patrol. You learn about crime scene investigations. You learn about the helicopter division. You learn about the police recruiting process. You also meet women leaders in the department.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 class has graduated and to check back next year for 2027 session information. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Get leadership, ethics and career training for law enforcement. Cadets get basic, advanced and specialized training. They get ride along time with officers. They get a chance to go to national events and skills contests.
deadline_text: The 2026 First Nighter meetings were Sept 1 to 3, 2026 (one for each unit). The page asks you to fill out an interest form for updates on future First Nighter dates. No deadline for 2027 is posted.

what_you_do: Spend summer weekdays at police headquarters. You learn about patrol, crime scene investigations, use of force, SWAT and police vehicles. You explore law enforcement careers. You do it through hands-on activities.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 class has graduated and to check back next year for 2027 session information. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: This is a four-week summer program. You explore STEM fields at Fermilab. You connect with Fermilab STEM professionals. The schedule has both on-site and off-site parts.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 12, 2027 and close Mar 1, 2027 (recommendation letter also due Mar 1). Offers Apr 12, 2027; accept by Apr 21, 2027.

what_you_do: Go to a free series of 11 Saturday morning talks and tours on modern physics. Topics include particle physics and quantum computing. You do not need a science background.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed and the session is full. The Spring 2027 session will be announced in November. The program announces fall in May and spring in November.

what_you_do: Take a free 10 class series on quantum science and engineering. Experts lead it. It shows you Fermilab careers and may include tours of Fermilab. Finishing can help with future internships and college portfolios.
deadline_text: Applications for Spring 2027 will open in late fall 2026. Classes run February 6 to April 24, 2027.

what_you_do: This is a six-week paid summer internship at Fermilab. Illinois JROTC cadets get hands-on technical training. It is in person in Batavia.
deadline_text: Applications opened Oct 5, 2026 and close Feb 5, 2027. Offers Mar 15, 2027; accept by Mar 22, 2027.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers staff interpretive carts that teach visitors about science, and help with museum programs for a full year. Training is provided.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications are closed. The museum expects to post information on the 2027-28 program in February 2027.

what_you_do: You get leadership training (decision-making, conflict resolution, teamwork). Then you volunteer with campers ages 6 to 10 in the Destination Recreation summer camp. You get a T-shirt and a Friday lunch.
deadline_text: 2026 post went up May 22, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: Join a volunteer shift in a warehouse. You check that food is safe and pack family-size boxes. You sort and repack produce and groceries. You also label containers.
deadline_text: Sessions are listed on a calendar at each location. No deadline.

what_you_do: Take real Foothill College classes for college and high school credit while in high school, on campus, online, or at Sunnyvale Center. Free up to 11 units a quarter.
deadline_text: No single deadline stated. Submit the form before you register each quarter.

what_you_do: Free, self-paced online job simulations. They copy real work tasks. You can compare your answers to model answers. There are over 250 simulations from more than 90 employers.
deadline_text: Always open.

what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. After an interview, the Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Apply online for seasonal and part-time park district jobs. The page says positions range from teens seeking a first job to highly skilled professionals.
deadline_text: Postings go up through the year. The district holds an annual job fair in late winter. Past press releases gave Saturday, Feb. 22 (posted February 18, 2020, 10 a.m. to 1 p.m., Prisco Community Center) and Saturday, March 11 (posted February 24, 2023, 9 a.m. to noon, Prisco). 2027 date not posted.

what_you_do: Join park clean-ups, adopt a park or trail, and help at events. The district welcomes middle school, high school and college students and school clubs, and says the hours can count toward service requirements.
deadline_text: No deadline. The Fall Day of Service was October 3, 2026. Adopt-A-Park runs April to September (or May to October).

what_you_do: You grow produce in a community garden. You sell it at the Conservatory's Farmers Market. You learn plant care, healthy eating, running a business and speaking skills.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026 Teen Corps are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You can help the horticulture, education or visitor experience teams. Tasks include weeding and planting. You can also help in the Children's Garden or at the Farmers Market.
deadline_text: Opportunities are available year-round. No deadline is posted.

what_you_do: You work with the teen librarians on library projects like book displays and decorating the teen area. You can earn more volunteer hours by leading events.
deadline_text: Three Tuesday shifts are listed for Oct 13 to Oct 27, 2026. The page says the group resumes August 18.

what_you_do: You take hands-on career classes in 11 industry sectors and 59 career pathways. Some courses are linked to local colleges, so they may count for college credit.
deadline_text: Students sign up during pre-registration at their home school. The pages I read did not list 2026-27 dates.

what_you_do: You volunteer at the Tri-City Volunteers food bank and mobile pantry. You sign up on the volunteer portal.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up for shifts on the portal.

what_you_do: You can take career and technical education classes at Fremont Unified middle and high schools in 15 industry sectors and 58 career pathways. Some are inside California Partnership Academies or regional occupational programs.
deadline_text: No dates stated. Choose courses at your school.

what_you_do: You raise issues that matter to teens and pass them to the City Council. You also help plan forums and workshops for other teens.
deadline_text: The page does not say when applications open.

what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about conservation. Teens volunteer all year on school holidays, breaks and some Saturdays (not in summer). A 1-day training is required.
deadline_text: No deadline posted.

what_you_do: Help campers ages 3 to 11 with activities, art projects and games during summer zoo camps.
deadline_text: Applications opened April 1, 2026. Next dates not posted.

what_you_do: Join the Teen Advisory Board to plan library programs and events. Or write book reviews for the library website. Each Board meeting you attend earns 1 hour of volunteer service. So does each approved review.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Do clerical, non-clinical hospital tasks. The page gives examples for its medical units, such as answering phones and checking on patient needs, but does not list tasks for high school students. You work one 3-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: The page says high school applications may open in early 2027. Spaces are limited and applications are only taken when there are openings.

what_you_do: Do a year of online and live leadership training. You explore careers, plan your education path and meet other teens and professionals. Juniors and seniors can get paid summer internships.
deadline_text: 2026-27 enrollment ran Sept 14 to 28, 2026. Next enrollment dates not posted.

what_you_do: Help library branches with 1 to 2 hour shifts. Tasks include shelving and clerical work. They also include crowd control at events and helping the Friends of the Library. Some branches have Teen Advisory Boards.
deadline_text: Applications are always accepted, but most projects are full and most locations have a waitlist.

what_you_do: Spend one summer week learning life skills and getting a close look at law enforcement careers.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle: applications due Friday June 13, 2025 at close of business; program ran June 23 to 27, 2025. 2026 and 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Juniors and seniors earn high school credit. They work under supervision at an approved job site. This can be an internship, an apprenticeship or a clinical experience. The job must match the student's career pathway.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page. Ask your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator for the application window.

what_you_do: Serve as a Youth Commissioner. You share what teens think with the Fulton County Board of Commissioners. You give it advice. You also join planning meetings and community service projects.
deadline_text: The page says applications are usually open in May near the end of the school year. A past call (2024-25 term) closed May 24, 2024. No 2027 dates posted.

what_you_do: You help with library events. You refresh library spaces. You prepare crafts for programs. Listed sessions include Cleaning the Classics, Knitting for a Cause and Crafting for the Community.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A teen volunteer orientation is listed for Sunday, Oct 18, 1:00 to 1:30 PM at the Main Library Conference Room (the page does not print the year; Oct 18 is a Sunday in 2026).

what_you_do: Juniors and seniors work in a job linked to their career goal and earn school credit. The program also covers apprenticeships. Students must job search and interview themselves, with help from the school coordinator.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the district page. Forms go to your school's Work-Based Learning coordinator; ask when the next semester deadline is.

what_you_do: You take eight weeks of business technology and job skills training, then work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. You also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Applicants get an interview, then summer skills training.

what_you_do: Volunteer for library tasks. After you register, the library emails sign-up sheets showing when help is needed and you choose time slots that fit your schedule.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 session runs Sept 14 to Dec 4, 2026. No registration deadline is listed. Dates for the next session are not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital departments for 3 to 4 hours a week during the summer program (up to 8 weeks). A few students are also accepted during the year.
deadline_text: Summer session dates and deadlines are not listed on the page I read.

what_you_do: Join clubs, camps and projects in farming, science, civics, leadership and health. Older teens can join Project Achievement contests. They can join state conferences and leadership programs.
deadline_text: No enrollment dates listed. Ask your county Extension office.

what_you_do: Start as a Gallery Guide: talk with visitors, help at the touch pools, and in summer spend a week helping with Camp H2O. Finish with a group community project.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 session starts onboarding with information sessions in October 2026; dates not posted yet. The 2026 summer/fall cycle on the page: info sessions in July, application deadline Aug 1, interviews Aug 16, orientation Sept 12.

what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Young men run a pretend 51st state. It has cities, counties, two parties, elections and lawmaking. You learn how Georgia government works.
deadline_text: 2027 information is listed as 'coming soon'. The 2026 session ran June 7 to 13, 2026. The 2026 memo says the Samsung scholarship application was due online by the first day of the program.

what_you_do: Join a school DECA chapter to prepare for college and careers. Members go to conferences, compete in DECA's competitive events and can earn a share of scholarships. The state hosts events like a Fall Rally.
deadline_text: No join deadline listed. The state calendar lists a Fall Rally on October 21, 2026 at Six Flags Over Georgia.

what_you_do: Join a school business club. It has learning programs and contests. It has state projects. It offers scholarships and awards. It also has state and national conferences.
deadline_text: No join deadline listed on the page.

what_you_do: Take agriculture classes at school and join FFA: leadership contests, career development events, Supervised Agricultural Experience projects, and state and national conventions.
deadline_text: No membership deadline listed on the page. Enrollment follows your agriculture class schedule.

what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Girls run a pretend state government. They hold elections, write bills and hear guest speakers. You learn how city, county and state government work.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: the 'I Want In' page said fee due April 20 and applications complete by May 20, 2026, while the Selection Criteria page said applications and fee due May 1, 2026. The two pages disagree, so plan for the earlier date and ask your unit. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: This is a mid-summer residential program on a college campus. It is for talented sophomores and juniors. Students study an area they were nominated in. It can be a subject, an art or a career field.
deadline_text: Local school selection runs August to early November (ask your school's GHP Coordinator now). Then nominees get the online application link Nov 13, info session Dec 3, application due Jan 8, semifinalists told Feb 5. The page shows weekdays but no year; they match 2026 to 2027. Confirm with GHP.

what_you_do: Serve for one legislative day at the State Capitol. Pages carry messages to senators on the Senate floor. They also watch votes and meet lawmakers.
deadline_text: No application deadline found. Pages choose a legislative day while the General Assembly is in session. The packet says the first 20 days of session fall in January and February. 2027 dates not read.

what_you_do: Take college classes at Georgia State while you finish high school. The classes count for college credit and for high school.
deadline_text: Deadlines listed without a year: Spring Nov 1, Summer Apr 1, Fall May 1. Late applications are not guaranteed a decision.

what_you_do: Take real Georgia Tech college courses while you are still in high school. Several courses are online (distance courses), and a limited number are on campus.
deadline_text: Windows listed without years: Fall apply May 15 to June 15. Spring apply Sept 25 to Oct 20. Summer (distance CS only) apply March 1 to 31.

what_you_do: You work in a team. Your team solves an open-ended engineering challenge. The challenge is inspired by real Georgia Tech research. You work with a faculty mentor. You present results at a poster session.
deadline_text: 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: This is a free, overnight summer program on the Georgia Tech campus. Students do hands-on experiments and workshops. They meet professors and students. They learn about admissions and tour campus.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026 session is closed. No application deadline is shown. Next session dates are not posted.

what_you_do: This is a state program with four options. Cooperative education is paid. Internship is paid or unpaid. Youth Apprenticeship is paid. Employability Skill Development is for students who already have a job. All of them link school courses to a work site.
deadline_text: Set by each school or district. No state dates are posted.

what_you_do: A state youth employment program run through local WorkSource offices. Services listed include tutoring, paid and unpaid work experiences, leadership development, adult mentoring, counseling, financial literacy and GED services.
deadline_text: No application dates listed on the state pages.

what_you_do: You research artworks. Then you lead tours. You also lead gallery activities for school groups and visitors. This is at the Getty Center or Getty Villa. You build public speaking and teaching skills.
deadline_text: The page says the application window typically opens in early February each year. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You can join free programs for high school girls. They include coding, with Code the Game for grades 10 to 12. They also include college access and leadership. Some programs offer paid summer internships at Bay Area companies.
deadline_text: Not posted. Contact Girls Inc.

what_you_do: You can join a free coding club for grades 3 to 12. It meets after school or on weekends. You can also take the free, self-paced online Pathways program for high school students.
deadline_text: Ongoing.

what_you_do: Take college classes while in high school. Dual Enrollment is for Glendale and Burbank school district students on an approved class list. Jump Start covers other students and other classes.
deadline_text: Registration opens Oct 19, 2026 for Winter 2027 (Jump Start only) and Nov 30, 2026 for Spring 2027 (Dual Enrollment and Jump Start).

what_you_do: Get work training at Glendale Community College's Professional Development Center. Then do 120 hours of paid work at a worksite. The site is picked to match your skills and interests.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Youth ages 14 to 24 get life skills, pre-employment training and paid work experience. GYA's home page says it provides up to 200 hours of paid work experience in retail, clerical and field worksites.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines posted. Use the Apply Now form and expect a call back in 3 to 5 business days.

what_you_do: Job readiness and mentoring for low-income youth. You learn to be on time, dress right and follow through on tasks. This helps you get ready for college and work.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes nurse assistant. It includes culinary arts and facilities maintenance. HVAC is another. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: Help with children's programs as a school year youth volunteer. Or keep the Innovation Center tidy and learn its 3D printers, laser cutters and sewing machines. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It plans library events.
deadline_text: School year youth volunteer applications opened August 15 and no close date is stated. Returning volunteers do not need to reapply. Teen Advisory Board applications are open November 1 to 30, and new members are told December 14 (no year printed on the page).

what_you_do: You work full time for 8 weeks. You do a one-on-one research project with a George Mason faculty mentor. It can be in person, remote or hybrid. You present at a final poster session.
deadline_text: The 2026 ASSIP Application is now closed. The page posts no date for the 2027 cycle.

what_you_do: Take lower-level college courses (100 and 200 level) at George Mason while still in high school and earn college credit. You can take up to 11 credits in one semester.
deadline_text: Deadlines are not stated on the page read. Admission is offered for one semester at a time.

what_you_do: Set career goals, take job readiness classes and get paid work experience. You earn high school credit for the job readiness classes.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Email to apply.

what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes carpentry, electrical and plumbing. It includes certified nurse assistant. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: A free, live in, structured program for teens who are behind in credits or at risk of dropping out. Cadets work on academics, leadership and life skills, and many can earn a GED.
deadline_text: No class start dates or deadlines on the pages read. Start with the online Interest Form and a required virtual orientation.

what_you_do: Five week paid, in person internship at a Georgia Tech Research Institute site. Interns work up to 24 hours a week on STEM projects with GTRI staff.
deadline_text: Pre-application launch is planned for December 11, 2026. The closing date is not listed on the page. The page says dates are approximate and final dates will be in the pre-application.

what_you_do: Two Saturday workshops in May, then a four-week paid internship in a county department. The page says interns develop leadership skills through workshops and on-the-job training.
deadline_text: Last cycle (2026 page): apply Feb 9 to Mar 16, workshops May 9 and May 16, internship June 1 to June 26. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: A free one-week academy with classroom lessons and hands-on activities. Topics include CPR and AED, emergency driving, and crime scene and crash work. You also learn self defense. You see K9, aviation and SWAT demos.
deadline_text: Last cycle: application deadline May 29, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.

what_you_do: Get a hands-on look at courts, police, jails and prosecutors. You work with assistant district attorneys and investigators. You also work with office staff. You can earn community service hours.
deadline_text: Applications for the sixth group open in April 2027 and the summer experience begins in June 2027. No deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch. Your role fits the branch, such as helping with programs or homework help. Teen Advisory Council members meet monthly. They help plan teen activities.
deadline_text: Apply any time. Applications stay on file for six months.

what_you_do: Work as a part-time seasonal lifeguard at county pools and water centers. First you must pass an In-Water Skills Test. You also take the American Red Cross Lifeguard Certification course.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: Volunteer as an aide at a county day camp for kids ages 5 to 13 for at least two weeks. Follow the camp supervisor's directions. No phones while volunteering.
deadline_text: 2026 form: turn in by Monday, April 20 (2026 camp weeks: June 1 to June 26 and July 6 to July 24, plus May 26-29 and July 27-31 at the Environmental and Heritage Center only; no camp June 29 to July 3). The 2027 form is not posted.

what_you_do: Classroom and hands-on training in traffic stops, investigations, crime scene work and self defense. Compete for Gwinnett in state and national contests. Help at community events.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: Spend Friday afternoons in summer learning about the legal system. You do debates and mock trials and watch live court cases. You tour places like the Gwinnett County Detention Center and the medical examiner's office. It ends with a graduation.
deadline_text: Applications were closed for 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A volunteer internship in a Gwinnett County department. The flyer lists communications, IT, law and public safety. It also lists recreation and water resources. Health and human services are listed too. There are more.
deadline_text: The county page says volunteer internships are available year-round. No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: You help build or repair affordable homes on construction sites. Younger teens can help with fundraising, flyers or lunch.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No sign-up deadline stated.

what_you_do: You help build and repair homes on a job site. Or you work in the ReStore. There you organize, price and stock items. You go to a one hour orientation first. Training, tools and safety gear are provided.
deadline_text: Rolling. Sign up for shifts after orientation.

what_you_do: You can join Hack Club. It is a free teen coding community. It has school clubs and an online Slack. It has game jams, hackathons and hardware events.
deadline_text: Join anytime.

what_you_do: In October you can join online challenges and livestreams, or go to one of over 500 local in-person fests. This year the event focuses on open source and open-weight AI.
deadline_text: Runs through October 2026; sign in with MyMLH.

what_you_do: You can join monthly volunteer projects for younger volunteers. Find them on the HandsOn Community Calendar. Filter by age to see which are open to you.
deadline_text: Monthly projects: sign up on the Community Calendar. HandsOn Tomorrow will not run in summer 2026 and no later dates are posted.

what_you_do: Teens do animal meet-and-greets, help with animal care routines and work as camp helpers. Good for future zookeepers and vet techs.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted year-round and reviewed seasonally. The last orientation listed on the page was Oct 18, 2025 (old); no 2026-27 date is posted.

what_you_do: Take college courses with college students, in person or online. Subjects are computer science, engineering, math and arts. There are also classes in humanities and social science.
deadline_text: For summer 2026, registration began March 2 and the application with transcript was due May 7. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer at district events and ongoing service projects such as senior programs, nature programs, special needs programs and theatre ushering. Teens can earn community service hours and work experience.
deadline_text: Opportunities are posted throughout the year. No closing date is stated on the page.

what_you_do: Teens help the Children's Room librarians with tasks like cleaning books and craft prep, in 1-hour shifts. Teens can also attend Teen Library Council meetings.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted during the school year. No closing date is stated on the page.

what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise three groups. Those are the Hayward City Council, the Hayward Area Recreation and Park District and the Hayward Unified School District. They advise on issues that affect young people. They also work on youth projects.
deadline_text: 2025 cycle: applications due Friday, May 9, 2025. Interviews were on Friday, May 30, 2025. No 2026 cycle was found.

what_you_do: Teen interns work in teams of three. They research and plan activities. They lead science, technology, engineering, art and math activities. These are for kids at participating libraries.
deadline_text: Hiring dates are not stated. Sign up for Hennepin County job notifications to be told about openings.

what_you_do: Help at a local Hennepin County library. Positions vary by library.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Ask your local library whether it has a teen opening.

what_you_do: You can join a free 15 month program (800+ hours) for Black male high school students. It has two 7-week summers plus a year of after-school sessions in coding, entrepreneurship and leadership.
deadline_text: The application page says applications are currently closed and to follow HGP social media or the newsletter for the 2027 application. The last posted deadline was Feb 21, 2025.

what_you_do: Join 15 high school students. You learn about art and how a museum works. You talk with artists and tour the collection. You help with public programs. You plan events for other teens.
deadline_text: 2026-27 cycle: applications opened Feb 1 and closed at midnight March 1 (2026); applicants were told by May 1, 2026. The page does not post the 2027-28 cycle.

what_you_do: Teens run hands-on STEM stations like Imagination Playground and virtual reality for visitors on alternating weekend days.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

what_you_do: Get a starter job with work-skills training, career coaching and money lessons. One sub-program puts high school students to work helping elementary kids in LA's BEST after-school programs.
deadline_text: The site banner says it is accepting applications but gives no dates, and its document library page still shows a 2022 summer banner. Call EWDD at 213-744-7300 to confirm the current cycle.

what_you_do: You greet visitors in the lobby. You escort people. You work in the gift store. You help in the cancer center infusion area. Duties are limited because volunteers are minors.
deadline_text: The program is full. The page says to check back January 2027 for when interest forms will be taken again.

what_you_do: Volunteer in a Holy Cross hospital or health center in a clinical, customer service, administrative or support role. Year-round and summer-only openings are listed.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: You can join this student group for health science students. It has skills contests, leadership events and health career exploration.
deadline_text: Join through your health science teacher.

what_you_do: Students under 18 can foster cats or dogs at home. They need a parent or guardian with them. They can also make no-sew fleece blankets for shelter animals. You earn service hours.
deadline_text: Rolling.

what_you_do: Pull invasive plants, plant native ones and pick up trash at the Bolsa Chica wetlands. After a 3 hour training, long-term volunteers can lead wetland activities. They can also restore habitat. Some host visitors at the center.
deadline_text: No deadline. Events happen monthly.

what_you_do: Pick a library role. Choices include tech helper, LEGO Club assistant and seed library packer. You can also help with a chess or D&D club. You can also do general branch help like crafts, cleaning and setup.
deadline_text: Most roles take online applications with no deadline. The Teen Tech role lists applications Aug 29 to Sep 12 and interviews Sep 15 to 18, but the page gives no year, so check the date.

what_you_do: Sit on a city youth board of 10 to 15 students. Help run the Junior Citizens Academy and Youth in Government Day. Give ideas to city leaders. Volunteer at city events.
deadline_text: The page says applications are now available, with no end date listed.

what_you_do: A one-year statewide team for teens with strong visual or performing arts skills. Members help plan arts programs, go to trainings, and lead an art booth at the Illinois State Fair and Camp Kaleido.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

what_you_do: A statewide teen team that works on food access. Members meet with food experts, plan projects, and may speak to community groups or elected officials.
deadline_text: Application due December 31, 2026.

what_you_do: A statewide teen team that plans health programs and events for youth and families. Members meet monthly online, go to a team retreat, and work at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

what_you_do: A team of 7 to 10 high school students who make social media content and tell stories for 4-H. They also cover events and work the PR booth at the Illinois State Fair.
deadline_text: The page has an apply link but gives no dates.

what_you_do: A one-day, hands-on public speaking training. Teens learn to tell the 4-H story to elected officials, donors and community groups, and can speak at state events like Legislative Connection.
deadline_text: Training dates are not listed on the page. Use the register link.

what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects. Older teens can also join state teen teams, like STEM Ambassadors, Healthy Living Ambassadors or the Youth Leadership Team.
deadline_text: No sign-up deadline is posted. Teen team applications and dates are not posted on the main teen page.

what_you_do: This is a week-long program. Young men run a mock state government on the Eastern Illinois University campus. There are scholarship contests. You also get lifelong alumni membership.
deadline_text: The registration page says registration for the 2027 session closes at 4:00 PM on June 12, 2027, when the session starts. Ask your local Legion post about its earlier sponsor deadline.

what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter to practice business skills in marketing, management, entrepreneurship, hospitality and tourism, or finance. Chapters compete at an Illinois state conference each spring.
deadline_text: The Illinois DECA conference is March 4 to 6, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency O'Hare in Rosemont, IL. No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: A week-long citizenship and leadership program for high school girls, sponsored by an American Legion Auxiliary Unit. Delegates must attend the full session.
deadline_text: Next session is June 20 to 26, 2027. The application deadline is not stated on the pages read; contact the Department office.

what_you_do: Spend two weeks on a research project with an IMSA faculty mentor. The 2026 projects included AI and cardiology or neuroscience, molecular modeling, Chinese history and building a game in Pygame.
deadline_text: The 2026 application portal showed closed. No 2027 dates are posted. Sessions in 2026 were in June and July.

what_you_do: Research education topics that affect Illinois public school students. Meet with policymakers and community partners, then present policy ideas to the State Board of Education.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed June 30, 2026 and late applications were not considered. Finalists were emailed in July for a video interview.

what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Squadrons meet about 2.5 hours a week plus about one Saturday a month, with summer encampments and career academies.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: Join a delegation and take a role in a student model of Illinois state government. Roles include legislator, attorney, lobbyist or press team. You use what you learn at a state conference.
deadline_text: Closed: the scholarship portal closed October 1, 2026 (decisions come before November 1). Not known: whether you can still register, the conference dates and a general registration deadline are not posted on the page read. Ask your Delegation Advisor or the state office.

what_you_do: Take a self-paced online course on how AI works, from machine learning to robotics, and on its ethics and safety. Weekly office hours with IMSA computer science faculty. You earn a certificate.
deadline_text: This cohort runs September 28 to December 18, 2026, so it has already started. Not known: the page does not say if registration is still open or what it costs. Email studentenrichment@imsa.edu to ask.

what_you_do: Take a self-guided online course. You plan and run a science investigation and write a science paper. It is the course you must take before the summer SRELO research program.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened January 26, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Do your own science research project in a year-long, mostly asynchronous online program. You find a mentor, write a research paper, make a poster and present at spring science symposia.
deadline_text: Registration opened Thursday, July 30, 2026 at noon. Spots are limited. Refund deadlines are mid and late September 2026.

what_you_do: A three-day, two-night stay in a Purdue residence hall. You pick hands-on workshops such as animal health, AI, food science, leadership and plant sciences taught by Purdue faculty and experts.
deadline_text: The 2026 conference ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration dates are not posted on the page and 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A three-day stay in a Purdue residence hall for youth who just finished grades 7 and 8. Attend career classes made for Round-Up and get a taste of college life.
deadline_text: 2026 event ran June 10 to 12, 2026. Registration was open through May 22, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Teen 4-H leaders train to speak up for Indiana 4-H, act as role models for younger youth and work with adults and community partners. Training and workshops are held July 30 to August 1.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were due April 15, 2026. Interviews were in the first two weeks of May and ambassadors were notified in the last week of May. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at a school with business or marketing classes. Members build business skills. They compete at the Indiana state conference.
deadline_text: The Indiana DECA conference is February 26 to 28, 2027 at the Indianapolis Marriott Downtown. No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Help at DNR properties. Jobs include working at nature centers, fixing trails and planting native plants. You can also pull invasive plants, clean streams, check birdhouses, or share photos and art. You set up your project with a property.
deadline_text: No deadline. Schedules are flexible and set with the property.

what_you_do: Career advising and job-readiness help for young people through WorkOne centers. Pay or work placements are not described on the page; ask the center what is offered.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Contact a WorkOne center.

what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture class. FFA is the student group tied to agricultural education in Indiana. Local chapters run the activities.
deadline_text: Indiana FFA says affiliation declarations are due October 1, rosters November 1 and student test numbers December 1. These are chapter deadlines for the teacher.

what_you_do: For one week, build a mock Indiana state government. Delegates form two made-up parties, run for office, propose laws, negotiate bills and meet real officials.
deadline_text: Registration opens January 11, 2027. The 2027 session is June 13 to 18, 2027. No registration deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character in a year-round cadet squadron. Cadets wear uniforms, learn drill, earn promotions and plan activities. You do not have to join the military.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: A free website where Indiana employers post internships and other work-based learning. Learners search by region and apply. High schools, colleges and employers can join.
deadline_text: No deadline. Postings come and go, so each one has its own date.

what_you_do: Write a research paper on a world hunger problem in one country. Then present it at Purdue to faculty, staff and industry experts. You also meet people in farming and food security.
deadline_text: Listed as Spring 2027. The page says registration dates for 2027 will be shared when available.

what_you_do: Learn how government works by acting it out. Delegates research and debate public issues. They take mock legislative, executive and court roles. Then they serve as delegates at the state conference.
deadline_text: 2026-27 conference and registration dates are not posted on the page read (it links only a 2024-2025 calendar).

what_you_do: You volunteer one 3 to 4 hour shift a week at an Inova hospital. You can pick a spring, summer or fall session. You learn about patient care, retail and operations.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 registration opens Nov 5, 2026 at 4 p.m. and closes Nov 8, 2026 at 11:45 p.m. Inova also runs summer and fall sessions.

what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes bricklayer, carpentry, electrical, painting and more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: Student reps from local high schools organize teen activities. They speak for their peers at community groups. Check the Instagram account for upcoming events.
deadline_text: The page does not list application dates.

what_you_do: You help library staff with programs and crafts. You also help with the seed library and toy cleaning. You can help run the Summer Reading Program. Or join the Teen Advisory Group (TAG) for service projects. TAG also gives feedback on teen programs.
deadline_text: The undated page says: Summer Reading applications ran May 9 to May 30, school-year roles reopen Saturday, August 1, and TAG is full with a wait list for applications after August 26. No year is shown, so confirm current openings.

what_you_do: Take one real UC Irvine college course in the summer, picked from a pre-approved list of courses numbered 1 to 99. Courses are taught at a college level.
deadline_text: Dates for Summer 2027 are not posted yet. Check the Summer Session calendar in spring.

what_you_do: Take regular IVC college classes while in school. You can take up to 11 units a semester, on campus or online. IVC also has high school partner classes and an Early College Pathway. It also runs an Irvine school district summer college.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Follow the steps for each term on the IVC page.

what_you_do: You will be able to join a new career center in Fremont, coming in early 2027. It offers a money-management simulation, a student business program and career summits with company mentors.
deadline_text: The page says the center is Coming Early 2027. No opening date or sign-up is posted.

what_you_do: Teens meet monthly at a branch. They suggest teen programs and library materials. They work on group projects. They earn volunteer credit.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers prepare program and distribution materials. They make displays and set up meeting rooms. They help with the summer reading program at a library branch.
deadline_text: The page gives a cutoff date for summer volunteer applications of 5/28/26 and does not say which branches it covers.

what_you_do: Free career training campus. The Georgia center pages list trades like construction and electrical pre-apprenticeships, bricklaying, carpentry, asphalt paving and Certified Nurse Assistant.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start at any time. The application process usually takes about two months.

what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. The center lists Advanced Transportation Service Worker, Building Construction Technology (pre-apprentice), Culinary Arts and Office Administration.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

what_you_do: You can get free live-in career training. Choose construction, carpentry, cement masonry or Certified Nurse Assistant. You also get help finishing high school. You can earn a high school equivalency.
deadline_text: Ongoing enrollment. No dates posted on the Sacramento page.

what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. Programs listed include Advanced Cement Masonry (Pre-Apprentice), Advanced Electrical (Overhead Line Construction) and Advanced Transportation Service Worker.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. Centers list computer and medical assistant, carpentry, cement masonry, human services, fire management and nursing assistant training.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

what_you_do: Help staff, patients and visitors at Walnut Creek Medical Center in a structured high school program. Students build skills in administration, patient interaction, communication, organization and leadership.
deadline_text: No application window is stated on the official page. Contact a partner high school (for example Acalanes, Campolindo, Las Lomas, Miramonte, Monte Vista, San Ramon Valley or Ygnacio Valley) to ask about the next intake.

what_you_do: You can join Junior Achievement programs on entrepreneurship, investing and personal finance, led by volunteers. Job shadow and Finance Park experiences are also listed, and a Silicon Valley Launchpad center is coming in early 2027.
deadline_text: No central deadline; ask JA.

what_you_do: You get a paid summer job. It is seven weeks and full time. The jobs are in healthcare support or admin roles. You also get weekly workshops, mentoring and networking. There is little patient contact.
deadline_text: Opens Nov 16, 2026 at 9am Pacific; closes Jan 8, 2027 at 5pm Pacific.

what_you_do: Join a monthly restoration workday in the forest preserves. Volunteers work in natural areas. Longer roles include trail adopter and nature center host. You can also be a historic site guide or help at special events.
deadline_text: No deadline. See the monthly list of workdays on the volunteer page.

what_you_do: You can get paid work experience. You can do internships and job shadowing. Apprenticeships are also an option. You get resume and interview coaching. You can get GED prep and tutoring. You also get help with life skills, transportation and child care.
deadline_text: No dates posted. You contact a provider and they explain how to start.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers meet with a librarian. They give input on library services. They help design library programs and events.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page lists upcoming meetings (for example Maple Valley, Lake Forest Park, Newport Way and Federal Way); contact the local library to join.

what_you_do: Volunteer for 8 weeks in summer. You work at Keck Hospital of USC or USC Norris Cancer Hospital.
deadline_text: The page lists the application period as Feb 1 to April 30, with recommendation letters due April 30 (year not stated). Orientation is the second week of June.

what_you_do: Weekly classes on police rules and methods, criminal law and the U.S. Constitution. You also do real-world training scenes. Volunteer at city events like Taste of Kennesaw. The page says cadets can earn over 100 volunteer hours in one year.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: You do service, leadership and fundraising through a student-led club at your school. If your school has no club, you can start one.
deadline_text: Join your school's club or start one. No cycle stated.

what_you_do: Live on campus and train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes bricklayer, carpentry, cement masonry, plumbing and more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: You can take free online lessons on the Khan Academy Life skills page. Topics include financial literacy, personal finance, entrepreneurship, career exploration and college admissions.
deadline_text: Always open.

what_you_do: Join a student board that meets monthly during the school year. Plan and run community events, like a self-care month and a service night at a museum, and speak for teens in the community.
deadline_text: 2025-26 board: applications closed May 17, 2026. The 2026-27 call is not posted on the page yet.

what_you_do: You can join a free coding program for girls and gender-expansive teens ages 13 to 18. Choices include a two-day Code-a-Bration or a two-week Camp in summer.
deadline_text: Sign-ups are open for Code-a-Bration (Nov 7 to 8, 2026 in Oakland and virtual; Oct 17 to 18 in Chicago and virtual). Summer 2027 Camp applications open in February 2027; closing dates not posted.

what_you_do: Two weeks of design practice in architecture. It includes a field trip to Atlanta. It ends with a talk about your work and an awards dinner.
deadline_text: 2026 session July 6 to July 17, 2026. Registration closed April 1, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: One-week hands-on career camps on campus. The 2026 camps are Baking and Pastry, Chef's Master Class and Medical Skills. The others are AutoCAD, Aerospace Engineering and Adulting 101.
deadline_text: 2026 camps ran June 1 to July 24, 2026. Summer 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet; the page has a contact form for updates.

what_you_do: One-week summer intensives in dance, theater, and arts and design. There are also music camps for jazz band, concert band, piano, choir and orchestra.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 page: registration opens November 1. Music camps: Jazz Band June 13-18, Concert Band June 20-25, Piano June 28-30, Choir July 5-10, Orchestra July 11-16 (year not printed, page is headed Summer 2027). No deadline is listed; spaces fill fast.

what_you_do: Paid summer internship at an arts or culture group. You work 120 hours over 8 weeks. Monday to Wednesday you are at your worksite. On Thursdays and Fridays you join program days with other interns.
deadline_text: Student applications open in March 2027 when internship listings are posted. No student deadline is posted yet.

what_you_do: Explorers learn what firefighting takes. They build leadership and discipline and do community service. They meet twice a month at their post and go on monthly ride-alongs. They also join yearly trainings and drills.
deadline_text: Open enrollment is usually held once a year in May. Exact 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A four-week summer ocean safety program at county beaches. Older returning teens can move up to the Life Saving Team (15 to 17) or Cadets (16 to 17).
deadline_text: Summer 2026 swim tests ran March 14 to April 12. The page says new Junior Lifeguard information is posted each January or February, and parents can expect registration in February or March. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You can help at your local library. Tasks include kids' storytimes and art activities. You can help with computer and printing help. You can clean and sort materials and make displays. Teen Advisory Boards plan programs.
deadline_text: No deadline. Ask your local LA County Library about current openings.

what_you_do: Do a paid, part-time first job with a local employer while taking a work-readiness class. You sign up through a nearby America's Job Center of California (AJCC).
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Fill out the youth interest form and an AJCC contacts you within 48 hours. In 2025 the summer jobs started July 1.

what_you_do: Teens help Metro learn what young people think about its plans, projects and programs. The council aims to listen, learn, engage, empower and build ridership.
deadline_text: Recruitment for the 2027 council has closed. No dates are posted. A sign-up form on the page gets updates on youth opportunities.

what_you_do: Core volunteers help zoo guests and support the Zoo's guest engagement programs.
deadline_text: Applications are closed now. The Zoo has a waitlist to tell you when they open. No dates are posted.

what_you_do: You learn how museum education works. You plan and run an art workshop with other teens. LACMA staff guide you.
deadline_text: 2026-27 cohort: applications ran July 1 to Aug 21, 2026 (5 p.m.) and are closed. The page says LACMA will not accept applications again until next year.

what_you_do: Help at the museum's events during the year. The museum gives volunteers a letter that verifies their hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. The museum says it frequently needs volunteers.

what_you_do: A structured summer volunteer program at the city zoo for teens curious about zookeeping, conservation and wildlife education. Builds customer service, time management and leadership skills.
deadline_text: 2026 application closed; materials were due March 13, 2026. The zoo page says to check back in January 2027.

what_you_do: Sign up for volunteer shifts at the food bank. Family Night projects include bagging produce and assembling senior boxes. Teens 14 and older can also volunteer at the Fresh Market.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can sign up for shifts up to 3 months ahead.

what_you_do: Help at the hospital without doing medical work. You might deliver mail, work the welcome desk, guide patients to their rooms, or do office tasks.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply online any time.

what_you_do: Juniors and seniors take career classes in areas like healthcare, trades, aviation, software and culinary arts, with employer partners and a Work Based Learning Capstone option.
deadline_text: Enrollment form deadlines: Dec 18, 2026 for Harrison, Jefferson and McCutcheon students. Feb 5, 2027 for West Lafayette students. No deadline listed for other schools.

what_you_do: A yearly event for high school juniors and seniors. You meet hiring managers from local companies like Subaru, Wabash, Kirby Risk, IU Health and Caterpillar. You explore careers. You can land internships or jobs. The focus is on making things and health care.
deadline_text: The page says the next event is Wednesday, April 29, 2026 at the Tippecanoe County Fairgrounds, which has passed. A 2027 date is not posted.

what_you_do: A spring course that trains you for a Red Cross lifeguard certificate. If you pass and the city hires you, you can work as a lifeguard at Lafayette pools.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Monday January 12. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A summer volunteer program. Kids and teens do light cleaning and park care for an hour a day. They earn Kids Can Passes for pools and Columbian Park rides.
deadline_text: 2026 ran June 1 to July 31. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: One week on campus doing hands-on research in a College of Agriculture lab. Faculty and grad students guide you. You do over 12 hours of research. It ends with a talk on what you found.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 are expected to open in December 2026. 2027 deadlines are not posted.

what_you_do: Seven days on campus to see what vet school and vet nursing are like. You do labs and demos. You also give hands-on care to a shelter dog, from checkup to ready for adoption.
deadline_text: Senior Camp is scheduled for June 20 to 26, 2027 and Junior Camp for June 13 to 19, 2027. The page links to an application form but does not say when it opens.

what_you_do: Spend a week living on Purdue's campus. You do hands-on work in agriculture and STEM. You visit research sites and labs. You tour agriculture companies. You meet Purdue students and faculty. You see what college life is like.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran July 12 to 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the camp page.

what_you_do: Live in a Purdue residence hall for two weeks. You take challenging courses with other gifted and talented students. The program also includes field trips and recreation.
deadline_text: 2026: registration opened Feb 2, 2026. Camp ran June 28 to July 25, 2026 in two sessions (June 28 to July 11, July 12 to 25). Payment was due June 1. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A week on the Purdue campus to try tech degrees and careers. It focuses on high school girls. Polytechnic students are your counselors. You earn one college credit.
deadline_text: The program page is out of date. It only shows June 23 to 27, 2025 and says registration is closed for TEAM 2023. Email techrecruit@purdue.edu to ask about the next camp before you apply.

what_you_do: A week on the Purdue campus to learn about tech degrees. You work on a week long project with Polytechnic teachers. You earn one college credit.
deadline_text: The program page is out of date. It only shows June 23 to 27, 2025 and says registration is closed for TOTAL 2023. Email techrecruit@purdue.edu to ask about the next camp before you apply.

what_you_do: A live Zoom session each month. Purdue physics and space experts explain space science. Students try fun tests and activities at home.
deadline_text: Next session: October 17, 2026. Sessions are the third Saturday of each month, subject to change for holidays and special events.

what_you_do: Live on campus for four nights and do hands-on science, research and presentations with scientists, instructors and college students.
deadline_text: Applications open in mid-March 2027. Student application due Apr 16, 2027 (5 pm). Teacher recommendation due Apr 23, 2027. Decisions Apr 30, 2027.

what_you_do: Spend a week on Purdue's campus. You work in teams of four on engineering design challenges. There is a final design competition. You also tour two engineering areas. You learn about 3D modeling, programming and robotics.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions were July 5 to 11, July 12 to 18, July 19 to 25 and July 26 to Aug 1. Registration for 2026 has closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You live on the West Lafayette campus for one or two weeks. You take a short college course. It is for 1 or 2 credit hours. Subjects include coding, cybersecurity, pharmacy, nursing, nuclear energy and business.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application opens December 1, 2026. Last cycle: priority deadline February 1, final deadline April 1. 2027 deadlines not posted.

what_you_do: At Fort Ouiatenon Blockhouse Museum, wear historic clothing and engage visitors in stories about the fort's history. Or help with the History on Tour traveling exhibit, or help at the Feast of the Hunters' Moon.
deadline_text: No deadline. Fort Ouiatenon volunteers are needed in summer.

what_you_do: Help run the library's Summer Reading Club: explain how it works, sign kids up, update the database and hand out prizes. One 2-hour shift a week.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: apply by Friday, May 22, 2026; required training day May 16 or May 23, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club and do hands-on projects, including livestock and non-livestock projects. The county page also links to county fair entry and the Indiana State Fair.
deadline_text: Enrollment for the Indiana 4-H year begins October 1. The county page asks members to enroll by Jan 15 (and says Jan 1 to keep traditional involvement). The drop/add deadline for projects is May 15 each year.

what_you_do: Help run a safe, supervised play area for children (6 weeks to 12 years old) while their parents work out at the Y.
deadline_text: Listed as currently hiring on the YMCA jobs page. No closing date.

what_you_do: A youth leadership group. It has workshops and community events that help you build leadership skills and confidence.
deadline_text: Dates are not stated on the page. The page says the guide has schedules and registration fees.

what_you_do: Volunteer in the hospital as part of the patient care team. You work in service areas. After an interview, the Volunteer Office finds you an opening.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Over three days, you join an issue group led by a teen. You meet elected leaders and policy experts. You hear from young people who made a change. You see state government at work.
deadline_text: The program page is out of date. It only lists the March 16 to 18, 2025 session. Email Darren Bagley at bagleyda@msu.edu to ask about the next dates before you apply.

what_you_do: Take part in a youth-led job and life skill program run by a neighborhood center in Lansing.
deadline_text: Dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals: socialize dogs and cats, walk dogs, do housekeeping or laundry, greet visitors, and help at events and education programs.
deadline_text: Next orientations: Nov 10 (5:30 to 7:30 p.m.) and Nov 20 (2 to 4 p.m.), 2026. Registration opens Oct 12. A Dec 8 orientation opens Nov 2.

what_you_do: Start in 11th grade and finish in 13th grade. Earn college credit toward a degree or certifications and get career-related experience.
deadline_text: Application steps and deadlines are not posted on the page. Contact a coordinator.

what_you_do: Help library staff with craft prep, program setup and cleanup, and handing out Summer Reading prizes. Some teens can keep volunteering during the school year.
deadline_text: 2026 applications were accepted April 15 to May 21. Orientation was May 27 or 28. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Pull invasive plants like garlic mustard and buckthorn from city parks, or help with rain garden and gardening days. The city gives you gloves, tools and refreshments.
deadline_text: 2026 work days listed: June 14, July 12, Aug 9 and Sept 20, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard, slide worker or customer helper at the city pool. You need no experience. The city trains you in May in Red Cross lifeguarding, CPR, first aid and AED.
deadline_text: Last posting was March 11, 2025 for summer 2025. No deadline was listed. The jobs page showed no seasonal openings in October 2026, so expect spring hiring.

what_you_do: East Lansing High School students can log limited volunteer hours. They do this by joining our Teen Action Group.
deadline_text: No current dates found. The library is not currently accepting general volunteers; TAG is the exception named on the current page.

what_you_do: Spend a week at a world-leading nuclear physics lab. You explore nuclear astrophysics research, run your own experiments, and learn how the science is used in society.
deadline_text: The program takes place in late July each year. Applications are open early December through March. Exact 2027 dates are not posted on the page I could read.

what_you_do: Spend two weeks doing nuclear physics at the FRIB lab with undergraduate mentors. It can turn into a year-long research project. Students may present their work at national conferences.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was March 15, 2026 and the program ran July 12 to 25, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the listing.

what_you_do: You sort food and build Weekend Kits in the warehouse. Or you help at Mobile Food Pantries. In season, you can help with the Garden Project.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts any time; many shifts book 2 to 3 weeks out.

what_you_do: Meet monthly with other teens to help shape the Think Tank maker space, prototype new ideas, and help with research on youth STEM learning.
deadline_text: No application dates posted. The 2026 meeting dates listed were Jan 24, Feb 21, Mar 21, Apr 18 and May 16.

what_you_do: Take regular college classes with LCC students while you finish high school and earn college credit. Homeschool students can take part too.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the page read. Dual enrollment information sessions are listed on the LCC site.

what_you_do: Audition. Then practice with a mentor and play with the pro orchestra at a holiday pops show at the Wharton Center.
deadline_text: Last season: application due Friday, Nov 28, 2025 at 5 PM, auditions Dec 4, 2025, concert Dec 21, 2025 at the Wharton Center. This season is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Join workdays in township parks and preserves, every other Saturday or every other Thursday, to help care for township land. Equipment is provided.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Join the email list with the sign-up form.

what_you_do: Stay on the MSU campus with about 1,000 other youth and choose from more than 100 sessions taught by MSU faculty, staff and 4-H volunteers. You live in a dorm and eat in the dining hall.
deadline_text: The 2026 event was June 24 to 26, 2026. 2027 dates and the 2026 price are not posted on the listing I could read.

what_you_do: Take regular MSU classes from an approved list while you are still in high school. You earn college credit.
deadline_text: The page lists an application deadline of Dec 19, 2026 for the term it codes SS27 (the page does not spell out the term name). Deadlines for the 2026 terms (April 11, May 30 and July 31, 2026) have passed. Apply at least 4 weeks before the semester starts.

what_you_do: Study what makes a great movie, then write, film, edit and polish your own short films in a group. The week ends with a screening in a campus theater.
deadline_text: 2026 camp was July 13 to 17, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A week on campus living in the dorms. Each day you learn about an engineering major with faculty and students, do hands-on team projects and tour research labs.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-December 2026. Deadlines by session: Session 1 June 4, Session 2 June 11, Session 3 June 18, Session 4 July 2. The page does not print the year; it is the cycle for students entering grades 10 to 12 in Fall 2027.

what_you_do: Spend one week on a single topic, such as pre-law or pre-med education, on the MSU campus. Commuter only.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 8, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: This is a residential week. You learn to code and design. You build your own video games. You use AI as a coding and creative helper.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-December 2026. Application deadline: July 9. The page does not print the year; it is the cycle for students entering grades 11 and 12 in Fall 2027.

what_you_do: Spend five days on the MSU campus with expert teachers. You build news skills like writing, photos, design, yearbook and news anchoring.
deadline_text: Dates for the next workshop are not shown on the page read.

what_you_do: Play the part of a country in a committee. Practice debate, teamwork and writing official papers. MSU students run the event.
deadline_text: MSUMUN XXVI is March 19 to 21, 2027 at the MSU Union. The register page shows a REGISTER NOW button. No closing date was shown on the pages read.

what_you_do: Take two advanced STEM classes and an enrichment class during a one-week summer program on the MSU campus. Choose commuter or residential.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was May 8, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Learn the basics of quantum tech. Program a real quantum computer. Tour a quantum computing lab. Get ready to apply to college. You stay and eat on campus.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was Saturday, April 25, 2026 (extended from April 18). 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week living on the MSU campus. Take a college prep class, a writing class, and an intro class in urban teaching or body movement science. Learn about scholarships and the FAFSA.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Friday, April 24, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Get job training, job coaching and a career plan of your own. Students try work at local employers through partner schools. Peckham serves youth with disabilities and youth with court records.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are posted on the page.

what_you_do: You teach guests at conservation stations. You work with the goat contact yard. You help in the Zookambi summer camp. You learn about zoo careers from zookeepers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. Information session dates and May 2027 orientation dates will be posted in January 2027. You must attend an information session to get the application.

what_you_do: You can volunteer in one of six teen roles at the hospital. Examples are discharge, patient and visitor guide, bedside DJ and mother and baby. You work one short shift a week.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are temporarily closed and are anticipated to reopen in mid-October.

what_you_do: Train in musical theater in a five-day intensive on the MSU campus. The Advanced Workshop is by audition and is open from rising 8th grade through college.
deadline_text: The page says more information about summer 2027 is coming soon. No 2027 dates are posted. 2026 prices are shown.

what_you_do: Write an original one-act play of up to 12 pages. Six finalists get a staged production of their play at the Wharton Center and a cash award.
deadline_text: Scripts are due Friday, Feb 5, 2027.

what_you_do: Take career classes as a junior or senior. You can choose car repair, welding, hair care, cooking or coding. You can also choose cyber safety, patient care, sports medicine or criminal justice.
deadline_text: The page says the application for Fall 2027 is open. No deadline is listed. First day for 2026-27 students was Aug 26, 2026.

what_you_do: You get a paid summer work experience of up to about 100 hours. You get job readiness training. It is through the City of Oakland's summer youth jobs program.
deadline_text: No dates posted. The Summer 2026 round is over; call for the next cycle.

what_you_do: You volunteer at your branch library. You organize the teen area. You build displays. You help kids with homework. You help with summer reading. Teen Council and Teens Leading Change add a community project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Teens Leading Change projects form in September, but you can join anytime.

what_you_do: Teens help Livermore Area Recreation and Park District staff. They run summer camps, sports, arts and crafts. They run recreation programs. They can join open space projects with park rangers. Volunteers earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: sign up for orientation by Friday, March 13, 2026. Orientations were March 19, 2026 (5 to 6:30 pm) and March 25, 2026 (4 to 5:30 pm) at the Robert Livermore Community Center. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: You can take free Las Positas College classes in high school. The classes focus on career technical pathways. Partner programs are in Dublin, Livermore, Pleasanton and Tri-Valley. Tuition and fees are waived. Required materials are provided.
deadline_text: Rolling by term.

what_you_do: You spend six weeks in person at Berkeley Lab, at least 4 days a week. You work on machine learning and data science projects, take computer science classes and hear talks from scientists.
deadline_text: 2026 applications opened Feb 2, 2026 and are now closed (the page gives no closing date). 2027 not posted.

what_you_do: You get a paid six-week summer research internship with a Berkeley Lab mentor. Areas include data science, experimental research, coding and science communication.
deadline_text: 2026 window was Feb 2 to Mar 22, 2026. 2027 not posted.

what_you_do: This is a free spring break camp at Berkeley Lab. It is for bilingual students. They are native Spanish speakers and English learners. It shows students careers in science, technology, engineering and math.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed; no 2027 dates posted.

what_you_do: You can get free career help at a youth center. Services include work-readiness workshops and help finding jobs. You can get paid internships or work experience such as Youth@Work.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. The competitive school-to-career programs (Long Beach Public Service Corps, Port of Long Beach internship, Fire Corps internship and others) open for set application periods.

what_you_do: You help lead activities. You assist staff at the League's summer recreation program for kids. The League says teen volunteers gain leadership experience.
deadline_text: The homepage showed a 2026 summer teen volunteer call. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: You can take a four-week online summer program about California policy. It includes talks from state leaders. It also includes professional skills workshops. You earn a stipend at the end.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 31, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
