what_you_do: You help run science summer camps by leading games and activities, preparing materials and supporting campers. Training is in May, and the job is full time in summer.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed January 15, 2026. Expect a similar mid-January deadline for 2027.

what_you_do: You staff exhibits such as the planetarium. Others are Ingenuity Challenges, Outdoor Nature Lab and Animal Discovery Zone. The minimum is 21 summer hours. During the school year, it is 2 shifts a month.
deadline_text: Paused: no new cohort in 2025, with a relaunch planned for 2026 (page text dates from Dec 2024). Last posted window closed Jan 16, 2024. No current cohort confirmed.

what_you_do: Help animal shelters. You can make pet toys, socialize cats and help at events. You can run donation drives and wash laundry and dishes. Or make graphics and photos. You do not handle animals.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up any time.

what_you_do: Youth members advise the City Council and the Livermore recreation district on what young people need. They also organize events that promote respect for diversity among Livermore youth.
deadline_text: Application dates not found. The city teen page that would list them returned an access block to our reads.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo two shifts a month and go to monthly meetings. Year one covers animals, conservation and guest service. Later years add projects, leadership, and career help.
deadline_text: The page says it is taking applications for Spring 2027. No deadline is posted.

what_you_do: This is a two-week summer program on the Loma Linda campus. It is for high school students interested in health sciences careers.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Jan 12 to April 12, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; expect a similar January to April window.

what_you_do: Take college classes at Long Beach City College while you are in middle or high school. Students with 12 or more units by senior year can earn a graduation medallion.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. See the college's Registration Dates and Academic Calendar pages.

what_you_do: Two youth members join seven adults to advise the Mayor and City Council. They give advice on city services for kids and teens. They also review the city's youth plan.
deadline_text: No application window is posted.

what_you_do: Cadets get advanced first aid and rescue training. They shadow Long Beach lifeguards and help instructors. The goal is leadership and a path to lifeguard or other public service jobs.
deadline_text: Tryout is listed for April 26 at 8:30 AM (year not stated; the age rule uses July 1, 2027). Interviews that day 11 AM to 3 PM.

what_you_do: Volunteer at local parks, after school sites and senior centers. You can also help at special events, youth sports and summer programs. Other spots are the Teen Center and El Dorado Nature Center.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Part-time city recreation job: plan and run activities for children, go to staff meetings and training, and keep kids safe. Hours can reach 40 a week from June through August.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page mentions a job fair on Saturday, Jan. 24, 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. at Houghton Park (year not stated).

what_you_do: Help the library staff. You put materials in order and support library programs.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Selected poets lead youth poetry programs. They get mentoring from local poets. They send work to the library book of poems. They read at a final show. The term runs May 2027 to April 2028.
deadline_text: Applications open Nov 14, 2026 and close Feb 27, 2027 (no late applications). Finalists told by April 2027. Finals May 22, 2027.

what_you_do: Teen docents work with museum staff, lead tours of the exhibits and the J. Gilbert Smith House, greet visitors and help at special events. They also take on leadership roles.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (the page says the deadline for this year has passed). The museum says to check back next spring for the 2027-28 year.

what_you_do: You can take free college classes while in high school. You can enroll on your own at a Los Rios college (special admit), or take a college class at your high school through an agreement between your school and the college.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Apply and register by each college's term dates.

what_you_do: Volunteer in many county rec programs and earn service hours. Look in the volunteer portal for teen openings.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Apply any time.

what_you_do: Student-led group that plans special events, runs marketing and media, and works on youth awareness projects. PRCS teen services staff mentor the teens.
deadline_text: Applications are closed for the 2026-2027 school year. Next opening not posted.

what_you_do: One day with county leaders. You have lunch with the Board of Supervisors, join a panel and tour a community center. You also sit on the dais during a Board meeting.
deadline_text: Page lists Tuesday, October 20, 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. (no year shown; matches 2026). No application deadline listed, so apply now or ask.

what_you_do: Help keep Lynn Canyon Park clean (age 10+) or provide support during the spring and summer mini-camps for kids (age 13+).
deadline_text: 2026 summer mini-camps were full for volunteers. The Ecology Centre answers applications within 10 business days.

what_you_do: Teens take field trips and do interviews to learn about jobs. They hear weekly career panels. They finish a career project at the McKenzie Regional Workforce Center.
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 30 and are due April 19. The page does not state the year, so treat it as a yearly pattern.

what_you_do: Interns work at one of 20 or more paid placements with outside employers. Fields include nonprofit work, health care, business, IT and science. You get weekly career training and a job coach.
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 30 and are due April 19. The page does not state the year, so treat it as a yearly pattern.

what_you_do: Get help with job searches, resumes and interviews. There is also mentoring and programs to explore kinds of work. Job placement gives teens income.
deadline_text: No deadlines are posted. Fill out the referral form any time.

what_you_do: A paid job for high school students. Teen ambassadors work on Wednesday evenings and do community financial wellness presentations and event tabling.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Hiring Day is Saturday, February 13, 2027, 1:00 to 3:00 pm.

what_you_do: Teens start a social business on Saturdays from February 13 to April 17, 2027, and can win cash prizes and college scholarships at the Teen Pitch and Launch Event.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Sessions start February 13, 2027.

what_you_do: Teens complete 90 to 144 internship hours at 15 to 24 hours a week. They also take job readiness training on June 15 and 17 and weekly coursework, and show their work at a showcase.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. Summer 2027 hiring day: Saturday, May 22. Job readiness training June 15 and 17.

what_you_do: You help kids play and learn at the museum. You can help with Rooftop Ramble animals and gardens. You can help in Art Studio or be a Play Ambassador. You can help in the outdoor Wonderground from April to October.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Shifts are filled first come, first served.

what_you_do: Lifeguards watch swimmers at the city's Goodman Pool. The city pays for the lifeguard certification class once you are hired.
deadline_text: Jobs are usually posted in January and stay open until filled. 2026 certification classes were April 4 to 6, May 8 to 10 and May 29 to 31.

what_you_do: Day camps from 9 am to 3 pm on trades, health, engineering, culinary and arts topics, with field trips. Students try hands-on career skills at the college.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 camp registration opens February 28, 2027 at 8:00 AM. Camps are posted in January.

what_you_do: Students earn their high school diploma and college credits at the same time at the Madison Truax campus. The program gives support, advising and a college success class.
deadline_text: No deadline is posted. Acceptance is competitive and based on space.

what_you_do: Youth volunteers help care for and comfort animals at the shelter, do service projects, or help in other ways. Most positions are a weekly 2 to 3 hour shift.
deadline_text: No deadline. Most weekend and after-school youth shifts are currently full, and there is no waitlist.

what_you_do: Youth help restore prairie and savanna. For example, they gather native seeds. They learn to name basic native plants. They also hear about jobs in natural resources.
deadline_text: The only session listed was Saturday Oct 10, 2026, 1 to 3 pm at Pheasant Branch Conservancy, 5000 Pheasant Branch Rd, Middleton. No later dates are posted on the page; check MyImpact or ask for new sessions.

what_you_do: These are paid teen jobs at the community center, with training. All teens earn ServSafe certification and get event catering training. They can also earn high school credit.
deadline_text: No dates or enrollment status are posted on the page.

what_you_do: Students volunteer at the Habitat ReStore or on home build sites. High school groups can also lead a fundraising project.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact Habitat to get started.

what_you_do: This is an eight-week summer program on conservation. You go behind the scenes at the zoo. You hear from local conservation groups. You work with animal care and environmental professionals.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 28 and closed Mar 1, 2026; notified Mar 2 to 13. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: Help at the zoo in roles such as gate greeter, goat yard attendant, events and wildlife champion. Training is given.
deadline_text: Applications for ongoing roles are posted each year between February and April.

what_you_do: Learn how an art exhibition is made. Create and run educational programs. Meet museum and arts professionals through job shadows.
deadline_text: The page says applications were closed for the 2025 Teen Forum. No 2026-27 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Juniors work in a UW-Madison research lab 20 to 25 hours a week for 9 weeks. They go to campus talks and show a poster in September.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 deadline was Jan 16, 2026. December information meetings were held at each high school. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Juniors and seniors work part of their school day for a local employer in a field they pick, with a mentor. They earn school credit and state-recognized industry certificates.
deadline_text: Current cycle: explore October to December, priority application deadline February 13 (the page prints no year, probably 2027). Interviews run March to July.

what_you_do: You do paid, hands-on conservation or construction work. You get mentoring while you work toward a diploma. You earn an AmeriCorps Education Award when you finish.
deadline_text: No deadline listed. The page says Legacy is accepting applications.

what_you_do: Help a library branch with tasks. Tasks include pulling books for holds and packing maker kits. You can package seeds for the Seed Library. You can set up for programs.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings change by branch and season; several branches had no openings on the day the page was read.

what_you_do: Youth volunteers sort and repack food in the warehouse during Food Sort/Repack shifts.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for a shift.

what_you_do: Three weeks on the UW-Madison campus focused on one college-level course (95 class hours).
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 12, scholarships due Apr 1, application deadline May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteers help lead kids on hikes, nature games and science activities at a summer day camp in the Arboretum. Orientation and training are provided.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Ask for the assistant naturalist schedule.

what_you_do: A residential camp on the UW-Madison campus with hands-on workshops, tours and recreation about the dairy industry. Students also do college prep workshops and stay in a campus residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A 4 week live online course on how college admissions, financial aid and choosing a major work. Small groups, guest speakers and about 1 hour of homework a week.
deadline_text: The posted 2025 session had registration Sept 15 to Oct 16, 2025 and a scholarship deadline of Oct 14, 2025. The current session is not posted.

what_you_do: Take a college-level course of your choice for two weeks on the UW-Madison campus. Residential students live in a residence hall.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 12, scholarships due Apr 1, application deadline May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Interns work in a cancer research lab with a mentor, learn lab skills and do a project of their own. They also join career activities with nursing, pharmacy and pathology.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran Dec 1, 2025 to Feb 6, 2026 at 5 pm. The page says to apply for the 2027 program next year.

what_you_do: Over two weeks, students do fruit fly lab work at home. They join faculty talks and cancer career panels. They also show a patient case study with grad student mentors.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 24, 2026, with notices in mid May. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: This is a three-week program on campus. You study math, physics, chemistry and engineering design. You do hands-on workshops. You visit industry sites. Faculty mentor you.
deadline_text: 2026 application is closed and decisions were sent. No 2027 deadline posted.

what_you_do: You volunteer in a UW Health hospital or clinic. You do it for a full semester. You need a placement interview and onboarding first.
deadline_text: Application closed now. Spring semester applications are expected to open Dec 2, 2026, with onboarding finished by Jan 8, 2027. Summer expected to open Apr 12, 2027; fall expected in July 2027. All dates are subject to change.

what_you_do: A program that supports students from 8th grade through high school graduation with advising, tutoring and college visits. Juniors in the summer do an internship with a campus or community partner.
deadline_text: The PEOPLE application opens at the end of January each year. Admissions are likely completed in May.

what_you_do: A 5 day camp where you stay on campus. Pharmacists and pharmacy students teach you about pharmacy jobs and how to get into pharmacy school (PharmD). You live in campus dorms.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was March 5 to 24, 2026 and closes early if spots fill. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: An online course where students design and carry out a project that tackles a problem they care about, in teams or alone. They practice leadership, teamwork and public speaking.
deadline_text: Registration deadline January 8, 2027.

what_you_do: A week on campus choosing a path in dance, theater, visual art, or fashion design and textiles. Each course ends with a performance or exhibit.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Jan 12 and closed May 15, 2026. Scholarship forms were due April 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A week on campus. You play in band, choir, orchestra and jazz groups. You take instrument and voice classes, composing and music tech. You also hear guest concerts.
deadline_text: 2026 registration ran Jan 12 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A day camp at Grainger Hall that runs 4 days. Students do hands-on activities and an entrepreneurial challenge to build communication, problem-solving and critical thinking skills.
deadline_text: Applications are open December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Space is limited, so apply early.

what_you_do: A one-day workshop at Grainger Hall. Students learn what entrepreneurs do and take part in an entrepreneurship challenge led by the UW StartUp Learning Community staff.
deadline_text: Applications are open September 1 to October 30, 2026. The workshop is November 14, 2026.

what_you_do: A day camp at Grainger Hall that runs 4 days. Students explore business careers, visit local companies for job shadow trips, and get help with college essays and resumes.
deadline_text: Applications are open December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027. Pick one session. A session may be canceled if enrollment is low.

what_you_do: An 8-week summer internship with mandatory training and weekly professional development. The library page says it is organized by Common Wealth Development for Madison youth to get involved with local government.
deadline_text: The library page does not post 2026 or 2027 dates. Check with Common Wealth Development.

what_you_do: This is free career planning, skills training and work-based learning. A career planner builds a plan with you.
deadline_text: No deadline. The page says the online application is coming soon.

what_you_do: Spend part of the week in class and part on a paid job with a business mentor. There are 16 program areas. It lasts 1 or 2 years.
deadline_text: No application deadline listed. Virtual information nights (7:00 to 7:45 pm): Nov 18, 2026; Dec 16, 2026; Jan 20, 2027; Mar 17, 2027; and Feb 17, 2027 (UW Health sessions).

what_you_do: Major League Hacking runs student hackathons. These are short coding contests. It also runs coding events. It has a 12-week remote Fellowship that pays a stipend. Most listed hackathons do not say high school students can enter.
deadline_text: Dates differ by event. See the 2027 season events list. California events listed: DiamondHacks (La Jolla, Apr 4 to 5, 2027) and LA Hacks (Los Angeles, Apr 16 to 18, 2027).

what_you_do: Volunteer at an aviation museum. Jobs on the form include exhibits, the front desk, the gift shop, collections, events, museum upkeep and aircraft restoration. No experience needed.
deadline_text: Ongoing. No deadlines posted.

what_you_do: A club that trains like a police academy. You have classroom lectures and hands-on practice. Cadets help at road races, fundraisers, dinners and city events. Cadets get a personal letter of reference.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by going to meetings.

what_you_do: Work a paid part-time apprentice position with a participating employer in a skilled field.
deadline_text: No state deadline posted. Ask your school.

what_you_do: Learn about Bay issues outdoors, join restoration events, meet decision makers, and plan an action project for your community. Summer Expeditions are multi-day overnight trips.
deadline_text: Summer Expedition registration begins each year in early January.

what_you_do: State internships, about 10 to 12 weeks, in summer or fall. Work depends on the posting; high school students can qualify when the agency has the need.
deadline_text: Summer applications open in February and fall applications in July. No closing dates on the page; check each posting.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a Frederick County library branch. Tasks vary by branch, interests and ability.
deadline_text: Apply any time. The branch contacts you about acceptance.

what_you_do: Work summer jobs at the city swim center as a lifeguard, swim instructor or front desk aide. The city offers lifeguard training if you are not certified.
deadline_text: The 2026 walk-in hiring event was March 23, 2026, 4 to 7 pm. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Start as a Zoo Guide answering visitor questions, then choose a track such as guest engagement or conservation and research. Teens get training from zoo staff, a uniform and a badge.
deadline_text: Teen applications are closed. The page says to check back in 2027. For 2026, applications ran Jan 29 to Apr 9, interviews were in May, and Boot Camp ran in late June and early July.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or a short-term 4-H program at a library or community center. Pick your own projects, build skills and enter competitions if you are 8 or older.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. All members enroll every year.

what_you_do: Spend a week running a pretend city and state. You campaign, write and debate bills, and learn how local and state government work.
deadline_text: The 2026 session was June 13 to June 19, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week at Stonehill College running a pretend state government. You take classes, run for office, join a band, court or newspaper, and play sports.
deadline_text: Session dates: June 12 to June 18, 2027. The site says applications open in late 2026. No closing date is posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a Mass Audubon wildlife sanctuary. Greet visitors, care for trails and gardens, help with programs, or log the wildlife you see.
deadline_text: No deadline. Positions are posted on the volunteer portal.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

what_you_do: Work a paid summer or school year job at a public, private or nonprofit site. You also take paid job training in skills like talking and leading.
deadline_text: No youth deadline is posted. Local programs set their own dates. Summer 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter at a school that teaches agricultural education. FFA builds leadership, personal growth and career skills. It does this through hands-on experiences.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You join through your school.

what_you_do: Take lab-based science and engineering courses with Smith faculty for two or four weeks while living on campus. No college credit is given.
deadline_text: Application opens Dec 10, 2026. Priority deadline Feb 1, 2027. Tuition assistance deadline Mar 1, 2027. International deadline Mar 1, 2027. Closes May 1, 2027 or when full.

what_you_do: Be a student voice on education in Massachusetts. Regional councils elect delegates to a state council that advises the Board of Education. The elected chair is a full voting member of the Board.
deadline_text: The page lists no election dates. Ask your school about its election.

what_you_do: Take a summer program of 1 to 6 weeks for high schoolers. Tufts teachers lead it. Topics include Mini Med School, engineering with AI, business basics, studio art and leading for social change.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2027 open Dec 14, 2026. Close date not posted. Aid decisions are made twice a month starting in February.

what_you_do: Take a faculty-led summer course for high school students in over 25 topics like STEM, art and design, and business. A six-week lab research option is also offered.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed (2026 deadlines were May 1 extended to May 15, May 15 and May 31 by start date). Research Intensives 2026 deadlines were March 15, extended to April 15. The site says Summer 2027 program details and applications will be available in January.

what_you_do: A paid summer internship in a UMass Lowell research lab. You work on real engineering or life science projects with teachers and student mentors. You learn lab skills and safety.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications were due Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: A paid internship at the museum. You go through a real application and interview. You work with the public, help with studio classes, and plan and present a research project.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the teen page. Check the museum's Job Opportunities page to see if it is hiring.

what_you_do: Live on the WPI campus for two weeks. Pick a STEM or business major and a minor in humanities, arts or business. You also get college prep workshops, trips and social events.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open in early December. The page does not state the year or a close date.

what_you_do: Support Mattel Children's Hospital and patient programs. You meet each week in summer and each month in the school year. You make art projects and hear from doctors. You also work toward a fundraising goal.
deadline_text: The 2026 window ran May 1 to June 6, 2026. Recruitment for Cohort 8 (2027 to 2028) is expected to open in May 2027.

what_you_do: This is a yearlong teen program. It includes workshops and visits from artists and museum staff. You get studio time and critiques. The program ends with a teen-organized exhibition and public event.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications were due Friday Aug 28, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted; expect a late-summer deadline.

what_you_do: You are a library teen volunteer. You give feedback on programs. You help librarians plan and run events. You speak up for youth services in the county.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club or program. It has hands-on projects, camps and STEM contests. It also has animal and environmental science, leadership and community service.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs, camps and events set their own dates.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Delegates run for city and state office. They take part in a political simulation. They hear from real leaders. There are college prep sessions too.
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 26, 2027 at McDaniel College. The 2026 application ran Nov 15, 2025 to May 1, 2026. The 2027 application dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter through your school's agricultural education program. FFA builds leadership, personal growth and career skills through agriculture classes, projects and competitions.
deadline_text: The state site lists a deadline to confirm or add chapter affiliation membership on Oct 15, 2026 at 5 p.m. The exact time for students to join is set by each chapter.

what_you_do: Serve as a page in the Maryland House or Senate in Annapolis. You serve for two separate weeks of the 2027 session. Pages hand out materials on the floor, run errands, help visitors and carry messages.
deadline_text: Each county sets its own application deadline and may have extra requirements. The 2027 session will have pages. Contact your county page coordinator now.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a model state government. Girls run for city, county and state office, take part in legislative sessions and a mock trial, and learn how government works.
deadline_text: 2027 session: June 20 to 25, 2027 at Salisbury University. The 2026 application ran Nov 15, 2025 to May 1, 2026. The 2027 application dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: This is a free career training campus. The center page lists pre-apprentice training in bricklaying, building construction and carpentry. It also lists Clinical Medical Assistant. More programs are under See More.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start at any time. The process usually takes about two months.

what_you_do: Sort, label and pack medical supplies in a 3-hour morning or afternoon shift. The supplies go to hospitals and clinics.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for a session before you arrive.

what_you_do: Summer volunteer spots in the hospital, based on what the hospital needs. They consider your wishes but do not promise them.
deadline_text: The 2026 program was full and its application closed. A waitlist was offered. Next year's dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Members help promote and improve the library's teen programs and materials. They plan events. They help with library projects. Members earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: Rolling membership. The page is accepting applications for new members and states no deadline.

what_you_do: Teens advise the Parks and Recreation Commission and city staff on youth needs, activities and programs, and help plan youth services. Members serve a one-year term.
deadline_text: Closed for 2026-27. The 2026-27 window ran May through July 2026 (page lists a July 17, 2026 deadline). The next window is not announced.

what_you_do: Join the local Civil Air Patrol squadron's cadet program. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can ask to join any time.

what_you_do: You take Merced College classes offered through your high school and earn college credit. The program is aimed at students who may not already be college bound.
deadline_text: You apply for each semester you plan to attend. No dates were listed on the page.

what_you_do: Take real Merced College classes while you are still in high school, tuition free (limitations may apply). Talk to your high school counselor about which courses fit your schedule.
deadline_text: No dates are listed on the page. Registration timing is on the College's When is Registration page.

what_you_do: This program helps young people who are out of school. It offers tutoring toward a GED or a diploma. You may get paid or unpaid work experience. You learn job skills and leadership. You get a mentor. It also helps you get into college or career training.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page; it has an online interest and application form.

what_you_do: Take career classes in several industry sectors at your high school as part of the Merced County ROP. The page links to a program brochure and a Career Industry Day page.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

what_you_do: You help patients and visitors. You might greet and guide visitors, do office tasks, help move patients, keep patients company, or work in gift shops. Duties differ by place.
deadline_text: The page does not say whether applications are open now. Ask Volunteer Services.

what_you_do: You can earn college credit in high school in three ways. Take online CCAP classes made for high schoolers. Take Merced College classes outside the school day. Or take college courses built into select high school classes.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the district page; check with your school's Pathway Counselor.

what_you_do: Finish a project management certificate course in spring, then work in teams on 60 hours of employer-led projects in summer.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 round closed Thursday Dec 18, 2025 at 10:59 PM. Next round dates not posted; it may reopen in the fall.

what_you_do: You help with library programs. You plan youth programs. You decorate the teen area and tidy shelves. You do community service projects. Shifts are 1 to 2 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Spend a week running a mock state government and court system with students from across Michigan. You learn how state government works. You also practice leadership.
deadline_text: The 86th session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at Michigan State University. The 2027 application is posted online. No closing date is stated on the flyer or page.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a model Michigan state government. Citizens are split into two parties, hold city, county and state elections, and learn how state government works. It is for rising seniors.
deadline_text: 2026 session: June 21 to 27, 2026 at Hillsdale College; application deadline was June 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: Students who are blind or have low vision get help planning the move from high school to college or work. BSBP runs programs for students in cities around Michigan throughout the year.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the program calendar on the page for current programs.

what_you_do: Share science with museum guests as a Nature Zone volunteer, Gallery Guide, or special events helper. Training is provided on the job.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A volunteer open house is offered.

what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter and learn business skills in marketing, management, finance, hospitality or entrepreneurship. Chapters compete at the Michigan state conference.
deadline_text: The Michigan DECA conference is March 11 to 13, 2027 at Huntington Place in Detroit. No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Get free help finishing school, training for a job, and finding paid work experience, internships, job shadowing, and pre-apprenticeships, with a career coach.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Call 313-962-9675 to ask.

what_you_do: Work a paid summer job or internship with a Detroit employer partner, after at least 12 hours of work-readiness training.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 13 to May 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: For 6 weeks, shadow health care workers, do hands-on and virtual reality practice, and give a group talk on a health topic. Then join monthly meetings from September to May.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 group are closed. Details for the 2027-28 group come 'in the new year.'

what_you_do: Learn about health careers through school visits and Saturday hands-on sessions (suturing, surgery practice, tours). Some students get a paid 7-week summer internship with a one-on-one mentor.
deadline_text: 2026 internship application closed April 30, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Shadow doctors and other health care workers in three 2-week hospital rotations, go to weekly classes, and earn a CPR and AED certificate.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed. Applicants were told by April 17, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Help at the science center with projects and guest needs. Training is given for each role, and you can learn about shows and changing exhibits.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time.

what_you_do: Work with research mentors in a lab for 6 weeks, build your own research project, and present it at a symposium. Fridays have lab safety, CPR, and career panels.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications ran Feb 23 to Apr 24, 2026 (5 p.m.). Program ran July 6 to Aug 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week on campus on real projects in coding, design, construction and game development. Special camps cover construction management, smart agriculture and aviation careers.
deadline_text: The page says all summer 2026 sessions are complete. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Talk with zoo visitors about conservation, lead science activities, and join workshops, field trips and behind-the-scenes visits.
deadline_text: Page says applications are now closed. No new dates posted. Past cycle closed in late spring.

what_you_do: Join a Michigan FFA chapter through a school agriculture class. FFA builds leadership and career skills. These are in agriculture, food and natural resources.
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Join a team of high school students that builds a robot with mentors from industry. The team competes at district events and the state championship.
deadline_text: No 2027 dates are posted on the FRC page. It only shows 2026 events.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital for one 4-hour shift a week for 8 weeks in the summer. You get a certificate and a letter that confirms your hours.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. No 2027 dates posted.

what_you_do: Join a school chapter, compete in health skills events at one of nine regional conferences, and the top finishers go on to the state conference in April and then the international conference.
deadline_text: 2027 state conference is in April at the Grand Traverse Resort. International conference: June 22 to 25, 2027, Philadelphia. Regional dates are on the 26-27 calendar page.

what_you_do: Spend a morning pulling invasive plants, planting trees or gathering native seeds with the park natural resources team. Tools and gloves are provided.
deadline_text: Workdays run through the year. Sign up by noon the day before each one. The workdays listed on the page were July 11, Aug 22 and Sept 26 (the page does not show the year).

what_you_do: Get paid on-the-job training with a local employer, a mentor, and lessons on soft skills like attendance, communication and managing money.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page read.

what_you_do: Work a paid summer job at a local worksite in a field you pick, with one day a week of classroom training on workplace and career skills.
deadline_text: 2026 program ran June 15 to Aug 14, 2026. Application dates for 2027 not posted.

what_you_do: Get help with job exploration, work-based learning, planning for college or training, workplace readiness, and speaking up for yourself. Staff work with your school and IEP team.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

what_you_do: Take a week-long exploration course at Michigan Tech. Topics run from STEM and engineering to business, the arts and the humanities. You can live on campus or commute.
deadline_text: 2027 registration and program dates are not posted yet on the pages read. Balances are due in full by May 1 and most scholarships are reviewed on a rolling basis.

what_you_do: Explore careers, join training, and take part in paid internships with local employers. Each work experience includes learning about career paths and job skills.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the Oakland NEXT application and staff will contact you.

what_you_do: Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets lead small teams and study aerospace. They sometimes fly in CAP aircraft. They go to a week-long summer encampment.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: This is free job-readiness help for young people who face barriers. It includes tutoring and mentoring. You can get paid and unpaid work experience. That includes summer jobs. You get skills training and help planning for college or a career.
deadline_text: Operated year round by local Michigan Works! agencies. No state deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. You take part in a student-run model government. There are fall district conferences. There is a big Lansing conference in February or April.
deadline_text: 2026-27: February Lansing conference Feb 18 to 21, 2027, regular registration Nov 10 to Dec 27, late Dec 28 to Jan 13. April Lansing conference Apr 22 to 25, 2027, regular registration Nov 10 to Feb 28, late Mar 1 to 17. Fall district conferences are scheduled Oct 2 to Nov 9, 2026 (registration closes two weeks before each), so some may already be closed.

what_you_do: A free program with a 5 and a half month stay on site and 12 months of follow up. You work on your diploma, leadership, job skills, fitness, life skills and community service.
deadline_text: Two cycles a year. The January start application opens Aug 1. The July start application opens Feb 1. The application takes place over the 4 to 5 months before each cycle. No closing date is posted.

what_you_do: This program provides education and job training for out-of-school youth. It offers high school equivalency prep. It also offers paid training in in-demand jobs. You do career exploration, work readiness and work experience.
deadline_text: No dates listed.

what_you_do: Youth commissioners advise the Milpitas City Council. They advise on matters that affect youth and teens. The commission meets monthly at the Milpitas Teen Center.
deadline_text: The city says commission applications are accepted year-round, and appointments are made as needed. No closing date is stated.

what_you_do: Join a cohort of teens. It has 15 Wednesday evening sessions from October to May. You earn a $750 stipend for full participation.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 applications ran March 2 to April 1, 2026, with interviews April 20 to 24 and notices in August. Next cycle not posted; expect a similar spring window.

what_you_do: You get a paid summer internship. Employers include parks, community groups, public agencies and nonprofits. The internship builds your first work experience. You get mentoring. You must finish a required orientation first.
deadline_text: The 2026 window was Jan 5 to Mar 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted; the city says applications open each January and offers a sign-up for 2027 updates.

what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club or county program. You learn by doing and grow as a young person outside of school.
deadline_text: No fixed deadline on the Join page. Membership lasts Oct. 1 to Sept. 30 and you re-enroll each year.

what_you_do: Spend a week at Saint John's University running a pretend government. You elect city, county and state officials. You go to classes and mock trials. You hear political speakers.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Each sponsor sets its own. Ask your school counselor or a local American Legion Post.

what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to learn business and marketing. You take part in DECA programs and contests, such as role plays. Minnesota DECA holds a yearly state conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines are set by the state advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 28 to Mar 2, 2027 at the Hyatt Regency Minneapolis.

what_you_do: Join an agriculture class and your school's FFA chapter. You build leadership and career skills. Members can go to leadership conferences, a winter leadership summit and the State FFA Convention.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

what_you_do: Spend one week at the State Capitol. You page on the House floor, sit in a mock committee meeting, and meet legislators, judges, lobbyists and reporters.
deadline_text: Complete applications are due by end of business on Nov 10, 2026 for the 2027 session. Selected students are told by email by mid-December.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aviation, fitness and character. You wear an Air Force style uniform and earn promotions. You plan activities. You have no duty to join the military.
deadline_text: Join any time. Visit a squadron meeting first.

what_you_do: Be one of the young people who advise the Governor and state lawmakers on issues that affect youth. You research issues, meet your legislators and hold a town hall in your district.
deadline_text: The 2026 round (for the 2026 to 2028 term) took applications from January to March 2026: Feb 28 for priority consideration, Mar 31 for all applications. No 2027 dates are posted. Seats also open when members graduate or step down.

what_you_do: Students write a research paper on a global food security problem and present their ideas at a one day event on the St. Paul campus. Top presenters may go to the Global Youth Institute in Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026: register by March 27, paper due April 3, event May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Help run Zoo Camps: keep track of campers, help with crafts and activities, and be a role model for younger kids.
deadline_text: Applications for the Summer 2026 ZooTeen camp season are closed. The page says to check the website in 2027 for next summer.

what_you_do: High schoolers take Mission College classes. Enrollment fees are waived and you pay only for books and materials.
deadline_text: No deadlines listed on the page. Follow the term dates.

what_you_do: Teens work with local artists and museum staff, plan and run MOCA Teen Night, and manage the Teens social media account. The group meets at MOCA on Thursday nights and some weekends.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed (over 130 applied). The next window is not posted.

what_you_do: Seasonal county jobs such as camp counselor, scorekeeper, field supervisor, lifeguard, swim instructor and cashier at pools, recreation centers, camps and parks.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Summer camp positions fill in spring.

what_you_do: You get a 5-week, 50-hour summer work experience. It is with a business, agency, college or nonprofit. The field is one you choose. It can be in person, virtual or both.
deadline_text: Student registration opens in January and runs January to February (year not stated on the page). Placements are announced in April or May.

what_you_do: You work as a county employee at a host site. Host sites include afterschool programs, a farm, communications, finance and special events. You have a coach. You get 30 hours of job training. You finish a capstone project.
deadline_text: Application windows on the page: Jan 2 to Mar 30 (spring/summer) and Aug 1 to Nov 30 (fall/winter). The page does not state the year, so the fall/winter window may be open now.

what_you_do: Help at stream and park cleanups and natural surface trail workdays. Some chances are approved for Student Service Learning hours.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. Browse the opportunities list and sign up for events.

what_you_do: Choose a 3-week series of health and STEAM workshops. Or choose a 6-week research project with an MSM mentor. You work alongside faculty and graduate students.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Jan 26 and closed Mar 25, 2026 (reviewed on a rolling basis). 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Take online college courses taught by Morehouse faculty. Plan on about 50 minutes a day, Monday to Friday. You earn Morehouse College credit for each course you pass.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Jan 5 to Mar 15, 2026, decisions Apr 5, payment due May 1. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Help in the Children's Garden as a Naturalist or Gardener. Or track how trees change through the seasons as a Tree Monitor. Returning volunteers can help at the summer science camp.
deadline_text: The page says applications are reviewed in April each year. An exact deadline is not posted. Email youthvolunteers@mortonarb.org to get deadline notices.

what_you_do: Teens join summer camps as Junior Leaders, help swim lessons as Junior Lifeguards, or assist at Deer Hollow Farm camps as interns. Training is included and it is free.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 Teen Summer Volunteer Program open in late winter or early spring 2027. No closing date posted yet.

what_you_do: Middle and high school students advise the City Council on teen issues, support The View Teen Center and plan teen events. Meets twice a month.
deadline_text: Page still shows an 'Apply now for 2026-2027' banner but gives no closing date; applications opened Feb 6, 2026. Recruitment for the next school year opens each February.

what_you_do: Learn about cancer research in summer sessions. You do fieldwork and a practicum. You go to a cancer research symposium.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline May 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Four weeks of hands-on health science. You do lab work, tutoring, SAT/ACT prep and workshops. You also job shadow and do community projects.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: apply Feb 1 to Mar 27, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: A summer program introducing high school students to regional problems like transportation planning, housing, environmental justice (how pollution and development affect different communities) and air quality. You hear talks from experts at partner agencies.
deadline_text: The 2026 program is over. The 2026 call was announced March 24, 2026; exact open and close dates are not on the page. 2027 not posted.

what_you_do: Help with library events, storytime, the seed library, shelving and the Summer Reading Challenge, or join the Teen Advisory Council.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline on the form.

what_you_do: Be the teen voice for the city. You plan youth events, art shows and community drives, learn how city government works, and pick up job readiness skills and volunteer hours.
deadline_text: The 2024-25 round took applications Aug 6 to Aug 30, 2024, with interviews in early September. Newer dates not found; expect a late summer window.

what_you_do: Youth volunteers help camp staff set up the classroom each day. They work directly with campers. They help with experiments, projects and activities.
deadline_text: No 2027 deadline posted on the pages read. Check with the museum in early 2027.

what_you_do: This is a paid library internship. It has 200 hours of library work experience. It aims to get local students to think about library careers. There is also a yearly scholarship.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications due 5 pm, March 27, 2026; award announced by April 30, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Meet hiring managers face to face. Past fairs also offered resume reviews, mock interviews and money basics. There was also a high school panel on career paths in Illinois.
deadline_text: Saturday, January 2, 2027, 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., Fort Hill Activity Center, 20 Fort Hill Drive, Naperville.

what_you_do: A team of 2 to 5 teens pitches an idea for a library event. If your team is picked, the library pays for supplies and helps you plan and run the event in summer 2027.
deadline_text: The 2026 application ran August 1 to September 30, 2026 and is closed. The page does not give 2027 dates. Teams picked for the in-person pitch are contacted by mid October 2026.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the library. Or join TAG, a monthly group. Teens work with teen librarians on events, books, games and teen spaces.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.

what_you_do: Support the mayor at community events. You greet people, answer questions and take photos. Hours follow the event schedule, with some evenings and weekends.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Apply for seasonal and part-time park district jobs. Jobs include lifeguard, swim teacher, camp counselor and paddleboat attendant. You can also work at concessions, park upkeep or a golf course.
deadline_text: The page's table says Centennial Beach jobs (lifeguard, concession, swim instructor), paddleboat jobs, camp counselors and Knoch Knolls nature camp jobs are usually posted in mid December. Other jobs post in May, June or August. The Community Job Fair is January 2, 2027.

what_you_do: Help run park district events. Examples are Kids' Night Out (climbing, crafts and games) and Santa's Workshop (greeting families, photos, goody bags). There are also Nature Champion volunteer days. You can get proof of your hours for school.
deadline_text: Apply at least two weeks before the date you want to volunteer. Santa's Workshop runs December 1 to 20 and Kids' Night Out runs November 20 to December 18 (no year printed on the page; weekdays match 2026).

what_you_do: Meet at the police department twice a month for training. You help with security and traffic at community events during the year.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the page.

deadline_text: 2026 class: June 11 to July 23, 2026, applications due June 4, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Sit on a city board or commission as a student rep. You might join the Library Board, Planning and Zoning, the Riverwalk board or the Transportation Advisory Board. You start with a leadership orientation.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications were due 5 p.m. Friday, Sept. 4, 2026. Selected students start at the KidsMatter Leadership Academy on Saturday, Nov. 7 (this fall). The city post is dated August 10, 2026. Next year's call is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Join one of 49 NASA science projects online. Examples include classifying images or tracking clouds. You need only a phone or laptop.
deadline_text: Always open.

what_you_do: This is a 12-week online program. You go at your own pace. It takes about 20 hours a week. Topics include space biology and bioinformatics. Bioinformatics means using computers to study biology data. Computational biology is also a topic.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 15 to Mar 15, 2026, or until 1,000 applicants. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Meet weekly at the museum to talk about art and learn how museums work. You also help plan an exhibit. In 2026-27 the council makes a show about climate and sustainability.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are closed. The page does not say when the next group is recruited.

what_you_do: This six-month program introduces you to several health care career paths. It includes paid shadowing. You have a chance to earn credentials that the industry recognizes.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026-2027 is closed. 2027-28 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You get a paid summer placement. It is a work-learning job in a hospital department. It is about 4 hours a day. It includes career exploration. You also get mentorship and financial literacy.
deadline_text: 2026 registration opened Feb 2 and closed March 27, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Join 4-H through your county office. Then take part in teen leadership and service programs. They are NC 4-H Congress, the State Council, the Honor Club and the new Clover Crew.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Programs and events vary by county and have their own dates on the NC 4-H calendar.

what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter at your school. Learn hands-on agriculture skills. Run a supervised agricultural experience project. Compete in leadership and career events.
deadline_text: The membership year runs Aug 1, 2026 to July 31, 2027. The state membership deadline is March 1, 2027.

what_you_do: Spend a four-day page week in Raleigh working on state government. Pages develop a policy proposal with officials. They tour government and historic sites. They do tasks for state departments. They plan a service project.
deadline_text: The application for 2026 is closed. The page says applications are taken on a rolling basis until spots are filled, so apply as soon as the next application opens. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Live on a college campus for four weeks and study one subject in depth: English, math, natural science, social science, Spanish, or an arts area. There are no grades or tests.
deadline_text: Application forms were released in Sept 2026. Local school deadlines vary and come in fall 2026. Selection news goes out in early to mid March 2027.

what_you_do: Serve for one week in the state House of Representatives in Raleigh. Pages work in the House chamber and at committee meetings, deliver messages and bills, and help with mailings.
deadline_text: Information on the 2027 House Page Program will be posted late this fall (2026). Applications are taken on a first-come basis until all spots for the session are full.

what_you_do: Live on a free career training campus. You train for a trade. You also finish a high school diploma or equivalent. Schenck and Oconaluftee are Forest Service conservation centers. They have wildland firefighting and forestry training.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start at any time. The process usually takes about two months.

what_you_do: Work for four weeks in a North Carolina state agency in the Raleigh area. You work next to women leaders in science, technology, engineering or math careers. You finish a group project.
deadline_text: 2027 plan: applications open early Jan 2027 and close in Feb 2027 (the FAQ says the firm deadline is the end of February). Phone interviews in March, notices in April, program in July 2027.

what_you_do: Plan and host the museum's monthly Teen Science Cafes. You pick topics, work with guest scientists, run social media and help lead each cafe.
deadline_text: 2026-27 applications are closed. They reopen in January 2027 and are due Monday, April 19, 2027 at 5pm. Group interviews May 4-6, 2027.

what_you_do: One week of hands-on STEM about extreme heat, flooding and air quality. You meet people who work in climate jobs and can lead a small service project at school or in your town.
deadline_text: Applications reopen in January 2027 and are due Friday, April 9, 2027 at 5pm. Program is June 14-18, 2027.

what_you_do: Teens support the museum's conservation work. They help with programs and events. They also do field experiences and service projects. They care for the live animal collection. The work runs September to April.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application period has closed. Applications reopen in January 2027 and are due in March 2027 for 2027-28 (exact day not posted).

what_you_do: Teens work on the museum floor for 10 summer weeks. They talk with visitors. They use natural history specimens to teach. They build speaking and customer service skills.
deadline_text: Applications open mid-January 2027 and are due 5 pm Monday, March 22, 2027. Group interviews April 13-15, 2027, 3:30 to 5:00 pm; top applicants are invited.

what_you_do: Free monthly evening event where a working scientist gives a talk, you do a hands-on activity, ask questions and meet other teens who like science. Also streamed on YouTube.
deadline_text: Next cafes: Nov 6 and Dec 4, 2026, and Jan 8, 2027 (6pm to 7pm). More are held on first Fridays during the school year.

what_you_do: Spend one week working in the state Senate in Raleigh. Pages work on the Senate floor and in committee meetings, deliver messages and papers, and help with office tasks.
deadline_text: The 2026 program is full. Available weeks for the 2027 session will be posted early next year. When it opens, applications are taken on a rolling basis until weeks are full.

what_you_do: Join a SkillsUSA chapter in your career and technical education class. Build job skills and take on leadership roles. Compete in state and national skills contests.
deadline_text: To compete at the national level, a student must be joined in membership on the SkillsUSA national site by March 1 each year.

what_you_do: Live on a UNC system campus for about four weeks. You do a hands-on STEM research project with faculty. You often work in a small team. Recent topics include ecology, biochemistry, DNA analysis and cybersecurity.
deadline_text: Application opens Oct 15, 2026 at cfnc.org. Essays are due Jan 5, 2027. Transcripts and teacher and counselor forms are due Feb 28, 2027. Decisions come Apr 2, 2027.

what_you_do: Play a concerto for a few North Carolina Symphony musicians. There is a first round and a final round. The page lists first, second and honorable mention prizes in each group.
deadline_text: Information about the 2027 competition will be posted in Fall 2026.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend state government. Delegates run for office, pass bills, hold court sessions and learn how city, county and state government work.
deadline_text: Application opens Nov 1, 2026. No closing date is posted yet.

what_you_do: Cadets fly, learn to lead, hike, camp and get in shape. Teens meet weekly with a local squadron and can go to summer encampments and other wing events.
deadline_text: No deadline. You can join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: Work a paid job with a mentor at an employer while taking related classes at a community college or training center. You can start as early as 16 while in high school.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Each employer or program sets its own hiring.

what_you_do: Take part in a mock legislative session with other high school students. You debate and vote on issues about local, state and national government.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 conference was March 13 to 15, 2026. Dates for the next conference are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the zoo each summer. High school teens can be Junior Wildlife Assistants at the Wildlife Rehabilitation Center. Jobs are diets, cleaning, feeding and vet observation. Teens can also join Camp Crew. Middle schoolers have other roles.
deadline_text: Recruitment for this season has ended. The FAQ says summer-only applications opened April 9 in 2026, and the Junior Wildlife Assistant page listed an April 22 deadline (no year printed). Check the site again in spring 2027.

what_you_do: Plan teen takeovers at the museum and advise on teen art shows. You go to artist workshops and learn about jobs in museums.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 council are closed. No date posted for 2027-28.

what_you_do: A one-week program where you stay on campus. You are matched with a mentor for a STEM project or research. You build leadership skills. On the last day, you share your results with families.
deadline_text: 2026 portal opened Jan 6 and closed March 5, 2026. Summer 2027 applications open January 6, 2027. No 2027 close date posted yet.

what_you_do: A free week-long summer program at NCSSM-Durham. It is a hands-on STEM program that mixes subjects. There are also online workshops during the school year.
deadline_text: Summer 2027: portal opens Dec 1, 2026 and closes Feb 3, 2027. Decisions March 11, 2027. Durham sessions June 13-18 and July 18-23, 2027.

what_you_do: Pick a STEM course taught by scientists, professors and engineers. Offered online or as sleep-away programs on the NCSSM campus in Durham or Morganton.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 details are not posted yet. The page says the application will open December 6 and stay open until all spots are filled. Admissions decisions are made monthly.

what_you_do: A week-long camp. You make green energy, biofuels, bioplastics and gels from plants. You also learn how paper is recycled.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 21-26, 2026 with a March 2026 deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A free weeklong summer institute, plus Saturday sessions in the school year. You do hands-on STEM and field trips. You can also get paid STEM internships in research labs and optional certifications.
deadline_text: Required open house for the 2027-28 school year: virtual Thursday Jan 14, 2027 at 7 PM, or in person Saturday Jan 16, 2027 at 10 AM at NC State. Open house registration links will be posted on the page starting November 2026. Application dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Online weekend contest for teams of high school students. You research a global problem, pitch ideas, build a prototype and present to judges.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 challenge is Oct 23-25, 2026. Register by Oct 12, 2026.

what_you_do: A week on campus doing hands-on plant work. You breed vegetables, grow new shrubs from cuttings and work with cut flowers. You visit farms, greenhouses and gardens. You also learn about college choices and leadership.
deadline_text: 2026 session was July 5-10, 2026. Deadline was April 1, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A week-long program for students who like farm and food jobs. You visit agriculture schools and research farms. You join leadership classes and visit farm businesses. You also tour the General Assembly and live in campus dorms.
deadline_text: 2026 program was June 14-19, 2026 and the 2026 application is closed. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A week of hands-on work with cattle, sheep, goats, horses and pigs. You also do lab tests on food, genes and biotech, and learn about jobs with animals.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 14-19, 2026 with a March 2026 deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: STEM classes for students in grades 6 to 12. There are fall and summer programs to get ready for a STEM major in college.
deadline_text: Late September for fall programs, late April or early May for summer programs (from the 2026 listing).

what_you_do: Research a global issue and write a 3 to 4 page paper with a teacher or mentor. Then present at a one-day conference at NC State. Top students may represent North Carolina at the Global Youth Institute in Des Moines, Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026 conference was April 16-17, 2026 with an early March 2026 registration deadline. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A four-week online research program. You meet with a faculty mentor twice a week, learn how research works and do a project. You get a certificate and a letter of evaluation.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 29 to July 31, 2026. Applications opened March 1 and closed June 10, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A week-long workshop where you stay overnight. You learn by doing about poultry science, animal medicine and jobs in the field. You also get info about scholarships.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 14-18, 2026. Deadline was April 3, 2026 at 5 p.m. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A week of field study, tours and hands-on sessions about saving natural resources. You also hear talks about college and jobs.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 14-19, 2026. Applications were due in late March 2026 (deadlines vary by district). 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: You live on the NC State campus in Raleigh for a week. You work in one engineering workshop. Hours are 9 am to 4 pm, Monday to Thursday. There are evening activities. A Friday showcase is for families.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: portal open January 12 to February 27, 2026; decisions March 27, 2026. The page says to watch for 2027 camp information.

what_you_do: Join a FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team that designs, builds and programs robots. Teams meet twice a week and go to scrimmages and tournaments.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Contact Kent Lupino for current team openings.

what_you_do: A six-day program where you stay on campus. It has ropes courses, service projects and group activities. They teach you about fair choices, talking with others and setting goals.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 dates are coming soon on the program site. The page does not list a 2027 deadline. Alumni can attend a one-day re-Challenge on Saturday, Nov 21, 2026.

what_you_do: A two-day camp. You do hands-on projects in the textile college's labs. They cover tech, engineering and chemistry.
deadline_text: 2026 camps were June to July 2026. Deadline was early June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: Four one-week sessions where you stay on campus. You explore textiles, fashion, engineering, polymer science and marketing in college labs and studios. You also go on industry tours.
deadline_text: 2026 weeks: June 7-12, June 14-19, June 21-26, July 5-10. Application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: A five-day camp about vet jobs. You tour the vet college and learn the basics of a small animal clinic. You work with horses, sheep and pigs. You also try stitching and dissection labs.
deadline_text: 2027 application opens Friday, Jan 29, 2027 at 9am Eastern. The page says it closes Monday, March 26, 2027 at 5pm Eastern (March 26, 2027 is a Friday, so confirm the date on the page). Decisions April 21, 2027.

what_you_do: Two-week summer workshops in the afternoon. You pick two creative writing classes: fiction, genre fiction, poetry, plays, or intro to creative writing. Your work can appear in a printed book.
deadline_text: 2026 workshops ran July 6-31, 2026. Deadline was June 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: Help counselors run a group of Kool Kids campers who are going into grades 1 and 2. You take mini trainings. You also write and lead at least one activity for your group.
deadline_text: 2026 camp ran June 29 to Aug 7, 2026. 2027 application dates not posted.

what_you_do: Work summer jobs at the Crystal Springs waterpark. You can be a lifeguard (training is given). Other jobs are lazy river attendant, guest relations, upkeep or slide tower dispatch.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer 2026 were posted with age cutoffs of May 1, 2026. Summer 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Sign up for monthly library volunteer shifts. Staff post the sign-up links each month, and each shift must be logged with the hour form to count.
deadline_text: New volunteers are accepted only in June and December. Next window: December (dates within the month not stated).

what_you_do: Join social events, meetings and service projects with other East Brunswick high schoolers. You build leadership skills too.
deadline_text: No closing date posted. Registration is on the Volunteer Matrix site.

what_you_do: You help prepare and serve meals. You clean and greet guests. This is at the Elijah's Promise soup kitchen. Shifts are on weekday and Saturday mornings.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts online; if none show, they are filled.

what_you_do: Earn volunteer hours. You can make teen social media posts, decorate the Young Adult Room, make bookmarks to give away, and write letters to seniors in nursing homes and to soldiers far from home.
deadline_text: The Teen Action Group form is for the September 2026 to August 2027 school year. Kindness Club needs no application, but teens must register for each meeting. Summer 2026 Reading Buddies applications are closed.

what_you_do: Help with library events as an unpaid volunteer. The library has its own form for volunteers under 18.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Apply any time.

what_you_do: Join the Teen Advisory Board to plan library events and run Homework Buddies. Or volunteer in summer to learn how the library works. Jobs include shelving, displays and book reviews.
deadline_text: The summer application goes up every year on the second Wednesday of June at 12 pm. School-year volunteer spots are limited to 5.

what_you_do: Take career and technical programs as a full time or shared time high school student. Majors include allied health, agriscience, and architecture and design. Others are on the career majors list.
deadline_text: No closing date is posted on the admissions page. See the page for open house dates.

what_you_do: Try career and technical education in a free summer program. It has classes and hands-on projects. It ends with a gallery walk.
deadline_text: The 2026 session ran July 6 to 23, 2026 and was at capacity (waiting list only). 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Pick a volunteer role. You can shelve books, tutor kids in chess or math, help patrons with tech, join Library Art Club, or plan teen events on the Teen Advisory Board. Hours earn volunteer credit.
deadline_text: Organization Club requires an orientation; the page says to check back for more orientation dates. Tech Helpers and Teen Advisory Board need an application.

what_you_do: Shelve books weekly, help at library programs, or join the Teen Advisory Board to plan programs, displays and teen-run events. The board meets about twice a month.
deadline_text: Weekly volunteering registration for 2026-2027 is closed. The page says Teen Advisory Board applications open in September, at the start of each school year. Join the volunteer mailing list for new openings.

what_you_do: Help at big township events like Founders Day, Haunted Tonight and International Celebration. You can also run kids programs, clean trails and pack food pantry bags. Or be a Shadow Buddy for children with special needs.
deadline_text: Volunteers are used as needed. No dates are posted for applying.

what_you_do: This is a year-round, multi-year STEM program. It includes a summer week at Rutgers-New Brunswick. You take lab tours and do research projects. You go to monthly meetings. You lead STEM activities for younger kids.
deadline_text: 2026 cohort application closed. The page says check back in early 2027 for the next cohort.

what_you_do: Spend a week at Rutgers Cancer Institute. You learn the biology and genes of cancer and how it is found and treated. You also learn how to lower risk and what jobs exist in the field.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed (acceptances by May 15, 2026). 2027 dates not posted. Join the mailing list at BOLD@cinj.rutgers.edu.

what_you_do: Spend one week on Busch campus doing hands-on engineering workshops, labs and projects. Rutgers engineering students and faculty lead them. Lunch and two snacks are given each day.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 dates are posted (July 13 to 31, 2026). 2027 dates and the application deadline are not posted.

what_you_do: Live on the Rutgers campus for one week. You take workshops and talks on one topic, such as space, engineering, pre law and mock trial, physical therapy or college readiness.
deadline_text: The Summer 2026 application is closed. Summer 2027 dates are not posted; the page offers an email list for updates.

what_you_do: Do a research project every morning. In the afternoon, work on group design projects. Rutgers engineering faculty and grad student mentors guide you. Bring a Windows laptop.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed May 1, 2026 (6 pm Eastern). Notices went out by May 18 and payment was due June 7. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: You can take up to two approved college-level courses at Rutgers-New Brunswick. You earn college credit. You take them during the summer.
deadline_text: 2026: applications opened February 2; last day to apply May 17 (Session I) and June 28 (Session II). 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: This is a one-week summer camp in the daytime. It is on the Rutgers Busch campus. It focuses on basic lab techniques and toxicology topics.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: enrollment opened January 5, 2026; deadline was Monday, March 2, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Free college prep all year. You get SAT/ACT prep, tutoring, college tours and STEM workshops. A six-week Summer Institute on campus is required. It has college-level classes.
deadline_text: The page says online applications open in mid-September and close in mid-December each year. A 2027 application link is posted.

what_you_do: This is a four-week residential summer program on the Busch campus. It is for math-talented high school students. You solve discrete math problems.
deadline_text: 2026: reviewed first come, first served from February 2026; completed application, including solutions to the problems, by March 31 if seeking a scholarship; financial aid applications by April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: You greet, direct and escort visitors. You visit patients on nursing floors. You help with patient discharges. This is at the hospital's New Brunswick or Somerset campus.
deadline_text: No application deadline or dates are listed on the page.

what_you_do: This is two weeks of lab work and bioinformatics. The work is on duckweed DNA at the Waksman Institute. Students' vetted sequences are published on GenBank with their names.
deadline_text: 2026 application opened February 2, 2026 and was first come, first served (sessions expected to fill). Application forms for the Summer 2027 WISE Programs will be posted in late January 2027.

what_you_do: Pick a library volunteer job. You can write book reviews online for hours, or help get program materials ready at the Community Service Club. You can read with kids as a Reading Buddy, or help at the summer reading club.
deadline_text: For summer reading help, sign up in April or May. Other roles run all year.

what_you_do: Help the township review its youth programs, suggest new ones, promote events and do service at township events. The board has one formal meeting each fall. The rest of the work is by email or phone.
deadline_text: Terms start each August. The page gives no application dates.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club, after-school program or camp and learn by doing. Topics are science, arts, healthy living, outdoors, leadership and citizenship.
deadline_text: No single deadline. Clubs and programs run through the year.

what_you_do: Spend a short summer session in a mock government. You learn how city, county and state government work by holding pretend offices.
deadline_text: 2026 sponsorships were filled and no applicants were being accepted. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a mock state government. You hear speakers, join discussions, run for office and take part in a sports program.
deadline_text: For the 2026 session (began June 21, 2026) the home page said applications were open through June 7. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Help patients, families and staff in a hospital, or work in a gift shop. You see behind the scenes of health care jobs. There is no shadowing of doctors or nurses.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer program applications are closed. The page lists summer 2027 program dates as July 5 to Aug 27, 2027 but no 2027 application dates. Seasonal and year-round tracks had no open positions on Oct 10, 2026.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

what_you_do: This is a free, four-week residential summer program for rising seniors. You take four courses. You do a small team research and design project. You visit companies. A final research symposium ends the program.
deadline_text: 2027 application not posted on the pages read. The state page (updated 11/13/25) said 2026 applications were open; decisions are emailed in early April. Ask your school counselor about the school nomination deadline.

what_you_do: As a senior, take free college classes at Mercer County Community College for dual credit. Choices include aviation, criminal justice, culinary arts, digital film, IT, pre-engineering and more.
deadline_text: The 2027-2028 application is open now. No closing date is posted on the page.

what_you_do: Spend half of each school day in a hands-on shop program in junior and senior year, such as carpentry, electrician, welding, HVAC, auto repair, cosmetology, culinary arts or game programming.
deadline_text: The 2027-2028 application is open now. No closing date is posted on the page. Info sessions: Oct 29, Nov 19, Dec 9 and Dec 16, 2026 and Jan 11, 2027.

what_you_do: Study a career and technical program in high school, such as carpentry, plumbing, welding, culinary arts, computer science, biomedical, finance, theater or health medical sciences.
deadline_text: Applications opened Sept 8, 2026. Deadline Dec 30, 2026.

what_you_do: Week long summer sessions with fieldwork, mentors from the field and a final project. 2026 topics: green architecture, water and climate, field research, and green infrastructure (with a landscape certification).
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran July 6 to 31, 2026 with full payment due March 18, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Plant rain gardens, work on trails, sample stream life, care for animals or greet visitors at a nature center. Different jobs have different minimum ages.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page shows the 2026 volunteer application. Next stream cleanups: April 2027.

what_you_do: Work in crews of 6 to 10 on community service and conservation projects. You spend about half your time on school work. It goes toward a diploma or equivalent.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. The program is described as year-round.

what_you_do: Write a paper on a global food or hunger issue, then present your research and ideas in a short speech and small groups at Rutgers. Some students are invited to a national event in Iowa.
deadline_text: 2026: registration and paper due by February 6, 2026; the Institute was March 6, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Take college courses while in high school for credit on both your high school and college transcripts. Classes are taught in partnership with local high schools.
deadline_text: The page links to a dual enrollment calendars page. No dates are listed on this page.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club or independent membership. Do hands-on projects. Topics are science, agriculture and arts. Others are leadership and community service.
deadline_text: No single deadline. The 4-H year runs October 1 to September 30.
