what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

what_you_do: Spend a week at a DEC camp. You learn outdoor skills like backpacking, canoeing and fishing. You study habitats and ecology. Some weeks offer hunter education.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026 opened Sunday March 22, 2026 at 1 PM and weeks fill quickly (waitlist available). 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week as a citizen of a pretend 51st state. You run campaigns, write and debate bills and fill county and state offices.
deadline_text: 2027 session: Sunday June 27 to Friday July 2, 2027 (from the site's save-the-date notice). No 2027 application deadline or registration opening is posted.

what_you_do: Work as a lifeguard at a state park pool or beach during the summer season. You pass a qualifier and complete lifeguard training. On Long Island the training is 40 hours and paid.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted on the page read. Register for a lifeguard qualifier; the page links the qualifier dates.

what_you_do: You can help in the Children's Department. Tasks include the Summer Reading Program and craft materials. You can write book reviews from home. You can join the Young Adult Advisory Council.
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are first-come, first-served and accepted as needed.

what_you_do: You volunteer next to city Recreation staff. Work at summer day camps, Pint-Sized Camp, the Marina Park Sailing & Boating Center and city events. You build leadership and work skills.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed Thursday, May 1, 2026. Next year's dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Build a marine science project and share it with museum visitors. You learn about museum research, collections and careers, and practice public speaking.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in February 2027 for the application link and deadline.

what_you_do: Volunteer to give one-on-one help in recreation programs for people with disabilities. Or apply for part-time jobs like program helper and summer day camp counselor. Programs meet once a week for 1 to 3 hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. NISRA says it hires summer camp staff each winter and spring. Postings are on the ADP Workforce Now site.

what_you_do: Spend seven summer weeks in a NIST lab on the Gaithersburg campus. You work with staff scientists and engineers on your own research project and may show it at a poster session.
deadline_text: Not open yet. The page says the 2027 job announcement is expected on USAJOBS in mid-October 2026, with applications due at the end of January 2027. A lower line says applications generally open Nov 1 and close in the last week of January, so the open date is not firm.

what_you_do: Volunteer roles at the City Library for teens, such as helping at programs. Spots are limited and first come, first served.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 registration is closed. Registration for January 2027 opportunities opens Dec 17 at 5 p.m.

what_you_do: Take the courses in order. They are Bronze Medallion, Bronze Cross, First Aid, National Lifeguard Pool and Swim Instructor. Then apply online for pool jobs with NVRC.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Help with swimming, young kids programs, fitness and special events. You can also help with general recreation.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Take a trades class while in high school. Examples are welding, millwright, car repair and electrician basics. The school district pays the tuition.
deadline_text: Deadline is the end of February for programs the next school year. Year not stated.

what_you_do: Take a 3 week college-level course on social and political issues. Do service projects with local nonprofits, meet community leaders, and make an action plan for change. Earn service hours.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 28 to July 17, 2026. 2027 dates and prices are not posted yet. The program has said to apply early for aid.

what_you_do: Volunteer one day a week for eight weeks in a hospital in the summer.
deadline_text: 2027 summer applications are open December 1, 2026 to January 15, 2027. The 2026 summer period is closed.

what_you_do: Spend 4 weeks on the Northwestern campus learning to report, write and produce news. Work with journalism faculty and professionals.
deadline_text: No applications before December 1, 2026. All materials are due by noon Central on March 1, 2027. Decisions by March 24, 2027.

what_you_do: Train in policy style debate in a 4 week or 6 week summer institute. The 2026 institute was fully online.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 application opens this winter. Rolling admission through April or until the labs are full. 2026 dates were June 28 to July 25 (4 weeks) and June 28 to August 8 (6 weeks).

what_you_do: Spend 5 weeks on the Northwestern campus making films. Take courses such as acting for the screen, sound and on-set work, and finish with a festival of student films.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 9, 2026 and regular deadline March 13, 2026, with rolling late applications for some concentrations. 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

what_you_do: Live on the Northwestern campus for 5 weeks. Take acting, voice and movement classes, work on a crew, and rehearse a full play with professional directors. Tracks: Performance, Stage Management and Design/Tech, Musical Theatre.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: early deadline January 2, 2026 and regular deadline February 27, 2026 (online form). 2027 dates are not posted yet. The home page says applications open in November.

what_you_do: You can work summer jobs at a NOVA Parks waterpark. Jobs include attendant, lifeguard, water safety instructor and cook. Uniforms and training are free.
deadline_text: Page says NOVA Parks is hiring; no deadline stated.

what_you_do: You can get free career coaching and training if you are an eligible young adult. You can also take a paid internship of about 400 hours if you are 18 or older. If you are 17, you can start with coaching and work readiness.
deadline_text: Open enrollment. No deadline posted.

what_you_do: You can get a paid summer conservation job at a national park, working outdoors on park projects. Each park runs its own program.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 season open in late January or early February 2027. Closing dates are set by each park and are not posted.

what_you_do: Join a free after-school team of 20 to 30 students and 12 to 15 pros in architecture, engineering and construction. You learn design software and present a team project at a year-end showcase.
deadline_text: Team selection emails start in September. The page gives no registration dates and no closing date, and does not say whether registration is open now.

what_you_do: A paid after-school internship at the Apollo. You see how teams build an event. Teams include fundraising, education and marketing. Others are operations, production and programming. You help shape the summer Teen Takeover event.
deadline_text: The spring 2026 application closed Friday, Mar 27, 2026. The next cycle is not posted. Check the Apollo page for the next cycle.

what_you_do: A paid summer internship with the Apollo production crew. You work on lighting, sound, video, building sets and stage design. You help put on the summer Apollo Teen Takeover event.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed June 26, 2026. Interviews were June 30 and July 1. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Grow and harvest food in the Children's Garden, learn botany, and teach garden lessons to kids ages 4 to 12. You move up through four tiers over the years.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 opened Oct 1, 2026. Submit your materials before Dec 4, 2026 to be invited to an interview. No final deadline is posted. Info session Sat Oct 17, 2026, 11 a.m. to 1 p.m.

what_you_do: A free STEM college-prep program for high school students. In the school year you go to Saturday classes and tutoring on the BCC campus. There is also a six-week summer program, with a three-week stay in a college dorm.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: Paid youth internship at the museum. You meet and interview artists, help curate exhibitions, make a zine and make your own art with 11 other teens. There is also a four-week Teen Summer session.
deadline_text: The Fall 2026 application closed Oct 4, 2026. The spring and summer 2027 dates are not posted yet. The page says teens can apply for fall, spring and/or summer sessions each year.

what_you_do: A paid, year-long after-school internship for 13 students. You learn what it takes to work in arts management and get help planning life after high school.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed Friday, June 12, 2026. The next deadline is not posted.

what_you_do: Meet twice a month with city leaders and other teens to find problems in Brooklyn and write policy ideas to fix them. The first group ran a teen wellness summit at Borough Hall.
deadline_text: The page says applications typically open at the end of the school year. Exact dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Eight sessions of free filmmaking training: planning, filming in BRIC's TV studios and editing. You earn a certification that lets you borrow BRIC gear for your own projects.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 (Cycle 9) applications closed Sept 27, 2026. New cycles open through the year.

what_you_do: Pick one fellowship. Teen Curatorial teens plan a youth art exhibition. Teen Media teens run a youth film festival called Concrete Stories. You meet weekly in person and do the real planning.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application deadline was Sept 24, 2026 (extended). Offers were due by Sept 30, 2026. The next call is not posted.

what_you_do: Eight weeks of free street photography with DSLR cameras. You edit in Photoshop. You finish with a student photo show at the library.
deadline_text: Cycle 4 applications closed Sept 27, 2026. New cycles open through the year.

what_you_do: Help care for the park by weeding, mulching and removing leaves, or pick up trash from salt marshes and beaches and log what you find. Staff give you tools and training.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for each event. Most activities run April to October. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Work with archivists, historians and teachers on Brooklyn history. You do research in the Othmer Library. You see how exhibits are made. You visit museums, archives and historic sites.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 program are closed. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Make art about social justice in a Brooklyn studio after school. Classes cover mixed media and printmaking. You also paint a community mural. Workshops are about college and jobs in the arts.
deadline_text: Last year (2025-26) open enrollment ended Nov 3, 2025, taken on a rolling basis. The 2026-27 dates were not posted on the page we read.

what_you_do: Join a team of 15 to 20 youth and two teaching artists. You research a community issue, design a mural, and paint it with neighbors from July to August.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the program page.

what_you_do: Spend time as an unpaid team member in the emergency department of the busiest hospital in Brooklyn. You help patients, support staff and watch different health care jobs at work.
deadline_text: Deadline to send all materials for each block (year not printed on the page): Block 1 (Dec 11 to Mar 10) by Oct 31; Block 2 (Mar 11 to May 31) by Feb 1; Block 3 (Jun 1 to Sep 2) by Apr 30.

what_you_do: Volunteer on hospital units or in the emergency room. You can also help in the children's hospital or with hospitality. You help patients and families. Many Brooklyn high schools work with the hospital.
deadline_text: The page does not state a deadline or whether applications are open now.

what_you_do: Four weeks in July with a surgeon as your mentor. You do a research project and watch surgery in the operating room. You use simulators and join lectures with residents.
deadline_text: 2026 application deadline was March 26, 2026. Interviews were the third week of April and decisions by end of April. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Take two college classes in art, design, architecture or writing for four weeks, build a portfolio and earn 4 college credits. Live on campus and show your work in an exhibition.
deadline_text: Not open yet: applications for Summer 2027 open in November (no day or year given). Scholarship application deadline Feb 1, 2027. International student deadline Apr 1, 2027. Payment due May 31, 2027. The main application deadline is not stated.

what_you_do: Remove invasive plants, maintain woodland trails and help restore the forest in Prospect Park. All tools are provided and you need no experience. You earn service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each event. The page lists Teen Service Series days through October and Park Pitch In weekends through November. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: You take a college-level course on Columbia's campus. There are 70+ courses in a dozen subject areas. Class is about 4 hours each weekday. You go home at night. You earn a certificate of participation and an evaluation letter.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open mid-November 2026. Early registration deadline Feb 1, 2027. General application deadline Apr 1, 2027 for the NYC Commuter sessions.

what_you_do: A paid, youth-led program for juniors and seniors. You study design objects and how designers work, then build your own team design project with other teens.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are open. Apply by Sunday, Oct 25, 2026 at 11:59 PM.

what_you_do: Take free college-style art classes on Saturdays. Choices are drawing, painting, sculpture, graphic design, media and architecture. Cooper Union students teach them. Juniors and seniors can join Portfolio classes.
deadline_text: The Fall 2026 application closed Sunday, Sep 13, 2026. Spring 2027 classes run Jan 30 to Apr 10, 2027. No spring 2027 application date is posted.

what_you_do: A four-week art program on the Cooper Union campus. You take a studio course such as drawing, painting or animation. Pro artists and Cooper Union student helpers guide you. You build a portfolio.
deadline_text: 2026 dates were: scholarship applications due Apr 12, 2026 and open enrollment due Jul 5, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted; join the mailing list on the page.

what_you_do: Take a 3 or 6 week college-level engineering or computer science class on campus. You do hands-on work like CAD design, 3D printing, circuits and lab experiments in small teams.
deadline_text: Applications for Summer STEM 2027 launch on Dec 11, 2026. The 2027 deadline is not posted.

what_you_do: Spend three weeks on the Cornell Tech campus. You learn AI, ethical coding, data science and product innovation. Then you pitch a project at a final showcase. No coding experience is needed. You earn two Cornell credits.
deadline_text: The summer 2027 application will open in winter 2026. The summer 2026 application is closed. No deadline posted. Rolling review.

what_you_do: A program to get ready for the High School Equivalency (HSE) test. You earn job certificates and do a paid internship. After a short school test, you are placed in one of three tracks.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Contact DYCD Community Connect (1-800-246-4646) to find a provider.

what_you_do: These are paid professional summer internships. They are with companies, nonprofits and city agencies in NYC. You get about 30 hours of pre-employment training first. It is part of SYEP.
deadline_text: DYCD page says the deadline for the last cycle was extended to January 16, 2026. Next cycle dates are not posted.

what_you_do: This program helps high school juniors and seniors explore careers. You get academic support and college application help. You learn to be ready for work. You do service learning and leadership. There is a paid six-week summer internship.
deadline_text: Page says enrollment dates are September 1 to 30 (year not stated). That window has passed for this fall.

what_you_do: Ages 14-15 do paid, project-based career activities. Ages 16 and up work paid summer jobs. Providers across the city place them. You learn work-readiness and financial literacy skills.
deadline_text: 2026 applications closed March 13, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: A job training program for young people who are out of school and not working. The program includes paid internships.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. Contact DYCD Community Connect (1-800-246-4646) to find a provider.

what_you_do: A school-year follow-up to SYEP. You take a CUNY course, join skill-building sessions and do a paid internship, with the chance to earn college credit.
deadline_text: The WLG application page lists a deadline of October 9, 2026, and that date has passed. The FAQ PDF lists the application period as Sept 8 to Oct 2, 2026.

what_you_do: Get a paid internship with a mentor. It is at a small business, nonprofit, government agency or large company. You also do two orientations and career workshops. You go on field trips to employers.
deadline_text: The application was closed when we read the page. No dates are posted. An interest form lets you ask to be told when it opens.

what_you_do: Work a paid six-week summer internship at a municipal finance company. You go to workshops and meet mentors in the field. You learn how money, government and public policy connect.
deadline_text: The application was closed when we read the page. No dates are posted. Use the interest form to be told when it opens.

what_you_do: Train for 8 weeks in business tech and office skills. Then work a paid internship at a partner company in your senior year. You also get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: Students apply in the fall or winter of junior year and finish the process in the spring. No 2026-27 dates are posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: A free college-readiness program for high school students. In the school year you get advising, tutoring and field trips. You also get help with college and aid forms. In summer you take a four-week class program on a college campus.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the pages read.

what_you_do: A four-day program that introduces chemical engineering. You do hands-on labs and team challenges. You meet faculty and alumni and tour labs. You also learn about college applications and aid.
deadline_text: Early registration is $400 before June 1 and $450 before July 1. The page does not give a final cutoff and says the program has filled up before. The registration form could not be read by this check.

what_you_do: A four-day program. You work with circuits, power and clean energy. You learn about AI, robots and computer security. You also try electronic design and bioengineering. You meet faculty, alumni and industry pros.
deadline_text: The page lists $400 before May 1 and $450 before June 1 and gives no final cutoff. The registration form could not be read by this check.

what_you_do: Pick one or more one-week day sessions on mechanical engineering. Topics include aerospace, AI, robotics and game design. You do hands-on workshops and design challenges.
deadline_text: The page lists a registration deadline of June 1, 2027 and the 2027 session dates, but does not say whether registration is open now. The registration form could not be read, so confirm it is open.

what_you_do: Take a business course on AI, management, marketing, finance or your own business research. You earn 3 college credits that can transfer. It mixes online weeks with one week on campus in New York City.
deadline_text: 2026 dates: domestic applications were due May 30, 2026 with answers by June 15; international applications were due March 16, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Live on campus for a week and try six kinds of engineering. They are chemical, civil, environmental, computer, electrical and mechanical. You do lab work and meet industry pros. You also explore New York City.
deadline_text: The page lists the 2027 dates but no registration deadline.

what_you_do: A free summer program for rising juniors and seniors. You hear lectures and do lab work and group projects. You try six kinds of engineering. They are civil, chemical, electrical, computer, environmental and mechanical. You learn how to apply to college.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted on the page. The listed session dates are for 2027.

what_you_do: Summer volunteering in non-clinical roles across Montefiore hospital campuses and health centers in the Bronx. Placement depends on hospital needs and your availability.
deadline_text: The page still shows Summer 2025 postings with high school applications January 1 to May 31. No 2027 dates are posted. Onboarding takes about a month, so apply early in spring.

what_you_do: JuMP is a 6-week summer program. Students aged 15 to 17 learn from healthcare staff in clinical and non-clinical areas. High schoolers can also join as Unit Support volunteers. They visit patients and help orient them.
deadline_text: JuMP applications are accepted January 1 to March 1 (no year given on the page; expect Jan 1 to Mar 1, 2027). Space is limited. The process can take 4 to 8 weeks.

what_you_do: A summer program for high school students. You volunteer in non-clinical roles around the hospital and see how a hospital runs and how patient care works.
deadline_text: The page still shows the 2025 notice: applications closed and the deadline was Jan 31, 2025. No 2026 or 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital. You might be a lobby greeter, a friendly visitor or a music ambassador. You might help in the emergency room, office or radiology. You give comfort to patients and staff.
deadline_text: Four sessions a year. Applications are due Mar 1 (spring), Jun 1 (summer), Sep 1 (fall) and Dec 1 (winter). Late applications are considered for the next session. The page gives the month and day but no year.

what_you_do: Start as a volunteer intern in the Everett Children's Adventure Garden. You lead hands-on plant and nature activities for kids and families and do a citizen science plant study. Later paid tiers exist.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 application closes Saturday Nov 14, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Open House Sat Nov 7, 2026, 1 to 2 p.m. (RSVP by Oct 30). A fall session also runs; its applications open late spring.

what_you_do: You volunteer in a hospital over the summer. The role matches the campus and the department. Placements vary by campus. You list your preferred program and location on the application.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted January 1 to March 31 (the page gives no year; expect Jan 1 to Mar 31, 2027).

what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital lobbies, outpatient clinics, children's units or other areas at Tisch, Kimmel, Hassenfeld Children's or Perlmutter. Roles are customer-service support, not clinical work or shadowing.
deadline_text: Applications open annually January 15 to February 15 (or until capacity is reached). The page gives no year; expect Jan 15 to Feb 15, 2027.

what_you_do: Spend a summer as a research assistant in one of many NYU STEM labs. You work with faculty and grad students. You build presentation skills. You present at a final colloquium.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 deadline was Feb 27, 2026 at 5 p.m. Summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: A six-year program that starts the summer after 10th grade. You get college guidance, career workshops, SAT/ACT prep and five summers of paid internships or enrichment programs.
deadline_text: The page says the last application is closed and the next one re-opens in Fall 2026. The page lists the usual due date as early February for current NYC 10th graders. The 2027 date is not posted.

what_you_do: Pass a swim test and a vision test. Take a 16-session training course. Then work as a lifeguard at a city pool or beach in the summer.
deadline_text: No test dates are open for registration right now. The page says qualifying tests run from late October through late February in all five boroughs. Sign up on the Parks site to get a notice when dates open.

what_you_do: Six-year public high schools where you earn a diploma and a free college associate degree in a STEM field. You also do work-based learning with industry partners. This includes job shadowing and internships.
deadline_text: The page gives no application dates. You apply through the regular NYC high school admissions process (MySchools). Check the MySchools site for the dates.

what_you_do: High school student leaders meet each month to talk about issues in their borough. Each borough then elects members to the Chancellor's Student Advisory Council. That council meets with school system leaders.
deadline_text: The page says members are often elected at the borough council meetings. No election or application dates are posted.

what_you_do: Do real field science outdoors in Alley Pond Park and around Queens. You count species, watch birds, test soil and water, and identify bugs. You also plant native plants. You finish with a talk.
deadline_text: Deadlines: Fall by Aug 1, Spring by Jan 2, Summer by May 1. The next one is for Spring 2027, due Jan 2, 2027.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a nature center for school credit or work experience. You help with the center's programs; fall and spring volunteers go one day a week after school.
deadline_text: Deadlines: Fall by Aug 1, Spring by Dec 1, Summer by May 1. The next one is for spring, due Dec 1.

what_you_do: Volunteer on the farm every other Sunday. You plant, harvest, compost, weed and build garden beds. You also learn about hydroponics, farm animals and forests. You learn about pollination too.
deadline_text: The 2026-27 application closed Oct 3, 2026 (acceptances Oct 6, 2026). An open house was held Sept 27. The next call is not posted.

what_you_do: Give non-clinical help to patients, families and staff in a hospital. Volunteers create a welcoming place so clinical teams can focus on care.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Call to schedule an interview.

what_you_do: A 9-month program of art workshops, leadership seminars, community service and career skills. You help plan teen events. You show your work in a public show at the museum.
deadline_text: Applications for 2026-27 are open. Deadline: Oct 25, 2026 at 11:59 p.m.

what_you_do: Work on the museum floor in a red apron. You run science demos and hands-on activities for visitors, and you join training, college prep and career workshops.
deadline_text: Hiring rounds in spring, summer and fall. The page lists open application periods of April 1 to May 1 and December 1 to January 2, and said fall hiring was closed and to check back in December. Exact 2026-27 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Take up to two real college courses with St. John's professors in the summer, on the Queens campus or online. The grades go on a St. John's transcript and earn college credit.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed Friday, June 19, 2026. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

what_you_do: This is seven weeks of team-based, mentored lab research on campus. You work with scientists from Rockefeller, MSK and Weill Cornell. You choose a question and collect data. You present a poster at the end.
deadline_text: Applications for SSRP 2027 open Oct 15, 2026. The deadline is not posted yet. The last cycle closed Fri Jan 2, 2026 (letters of recommendation due Jan 5), with Zoom interviews in March and decisions in April.

what_you_do: A year-long after-school program on leadership and life after high school. You practice public speaking, learn about college and career paths and meet professionals.
deadline_text: Applications are open. Deadline: Oct 16, 2026.

what_you_do: A senior-year internship. You build resume, interview and money skills. You help with Sadie Nash community organizing. You plan a social justice project for your community.
deadline_text: Applications are open. Deadline: Oct 16, 2026.

what_you_do: An after-school program with workshops on identity, healthy relationships, media and youth activism. There are also field trips and conferences. There is a year-long version in person and a 10-week virtual version.
deadline_text: Applications are open. Deadline: Oct 16, 2026.

what_you_do: A 6-week summer leadership program. You take classes on identity, social justice and leadership. You meet women and gender-expansive leaders. You go on field trips and college visits.
deadline_text: The 2026 application closed. Its deadline was March 13, 2026, with group interviews April 7 to 11 in NYC. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Learn an old trade like tinsmithing or broom making. Or help the education team behind the scenes. You also practice customer service and public history skills during Open Village.
deadline_text: The interest form opens each March. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer one afternoon a week for six weeks. You work with hospital staff. You explore careers. They include nursing, lab work and radiology. You also see physical therapy and respiratory therapy.
deadline_text: No session dates or deadline are posted on the page.

what_you_do: Work as a teacher's helper in college youth classes. Classes include musical theater, acting, dance, fine arts, computers and Lego robotics. You help with projects and set up materials. You keep kids safe at drop-off and pick-up.
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed. The page gives the fall session as Oct 2 to Dec 12 (year not stated). Spring dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Take a 10-week course on wildlife, conservation and zoo history. Then explain animal habitats to visitors. You also show ambassador animals at programs and events. You learn to talk to guests.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026 Docent Class closed Friday, Sept 18, 2026. The next class dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Help at the zoo in teen roles. Examples are Zoofari counselor helper and Education volunteer. Zoo staff train and supervise you.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted on a rolling basis. Placement depends on availability.

what_you_do: A free eight-month photography program. You learn photography, meet artists, take field trips, make your own photo project and help show your work in a museum exhibition.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 program are open. The deadline is Nov 6, 2026 at 11:59 PM.

what_you_do: Join other teens to work on safer streets, better buses and subways, and bike access. You go to monthly meetings and social hangouts and help with campaigns like free student transit.
deadline_text: No deadline. The NYC Public Schools opportunities page lists it as rolling.

what_you_do: A youth-led program for teens who want to get other young people to vote. You join weekly meetings, take summer trips to learn about city issues, host voter events and help create content and a research project.
deadline_text: The Youth page says applications for 2026 are now closed. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Help run weekend art and storytime programs for families at Wave Hill. You set up materials, talk with kids and parents about nature and art, and plan a workshop as a team.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back next winter for 2027 internships. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Work in a small crew in the woods at Wave Hill. You build trails, remove invasive plants and help restore the woodland. You also take a college course on city ecology.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back next winter for 2027 internships. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: A 14-month paid program. You do fieldwork and real science research with local scientists, take three college courses and finish with your own mentored research project.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back next winter for 2027 internships. No 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: You teach zoo and aquarium visitors about animals. You do fun activities. You help with education programs. You support WCS conservation campaigns. You can move up over the seasons.
deadline_text: Not accepting applications now. Applications for the next cycle open in late December 2026 for Spring 2027. No closing date posted.

what_you_do: These are free art and arts-career programs for NYC high schoolers. Graduates can apply to YI Leaders. It is a yearlong paid after-school internship. Teens plan public programs, lead gallery tours and write for the teen blog.
deadline_text: YI Artists (this semester) deadline was Sep 9, 2026 (extended). YI Arts Careers and YI Introductions list no 2026 deadline and reopen in Summer 2027. No YI Leaders deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Career-focused classes in 14 areas such as healthcare, digital technology, construction and hospitality. Includes work-based learning like job shadowing, internships and apprenticeships, plus industry certifications.
deadline_text: Enroll through the regular NYC high school admissions process. Dates are not stated on the CTE page.

what_you_do: 9th and 10th graders take career readiness classes. Juniors can apply for a paid apprenticeship. It lasts 2 to 3 years. You work at a workplace while you finish high school. You earn a state-registered credential.
deadline_text: Dates are not stated. Juniors apply during the school year; ask your school.

what_you_do: A teen-led group that helps create library programs. It promotes library services and serves the community. It gives teens a voice and ways to lead.
deadline_text: No dates are posted. The page has an Apply now button.

what_you_do: Volunteer at park district events like Winter Fest, Fall Fest, concerts and the Frank Lloyd Wright Races, or help at the ice show and other programs. Earn rewards for your hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Work a summer job at parks, recreation centers, pools, camps and youth programs. The district says it is the largest youth employer in the area. It hires about 300 summer workers a year.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the jobs page. Applications are kept for one year, then you must reapply.

what_you_do: You get paid summer work experience of up to about 100 hours, with job readiness training, through partner nonprofits. You apply to the partner group, not the City.
deadline_text: Deadlines vary by partner. For Summer 2026 one partner (ACOE) closed recruitment June 18, 2026. 2027 dates not posted; check partner sites in early 2027.

what_you_do: If you are an Oakland youth, you can get job readiness training. You can get work-based learning. You can get paid work experience. You get these through one of three partner agencies.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Contact the partners for the current cycle.

what_you_do: You can apply for part-time and seasonal City recreation jobs, such as recreation aide, recreation leader, recreation specialist, sports official, lifeguard, water safety instructor and pool staff.
deadline_text: Deadline Oct 25, 2026 for Spring/Summer 2027 starts; Feb 7, 2027 for Summer 2027 starts; Aug 8, 2027 for Fall/Winter 2027 starts.

what_you_do: You can join a monthly teen group that works with library staff on projects and programs and earns service credit. It meets at Main (TeenZone), 81st Ave, Asian, Cesar Chavez, Dimond and Rockridge branches.
deadline_text: Rolling

what_you_do: You help at a library branch with teen programs, social media, book and film picks, and art and design projects. The hours count as community service.
deadline_text: Rolling. Not every branch has space at all times.

what_you_do: You spend about 200 hours over 7 weeks teaching guests in the Habitarium and California Trail. Up to 6 interns are chosen.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Teens learn to teach visitors about animals at the Valley Children's Zoo. They run the petting yard. Later, they can help keepers on service projects.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 info meetings Aug 15 and 16, applications due Sept 1, 2026, trainings Sept 26 and Oct 4. The page says applications are accepted year-round and later ones are reviewed in the next enrollment period.

what_you_do: Help run summer day camp at the zoo. Teen Assistants volunteer. Teacher and Administrative Interns (grades 11 and 12, with camp experience) earn a $400 weekly stipend.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened Feb 1 and closed April 1, 2026 at 5pm. Summer 2027 dates not posted yet; the page says to check back.

what_you_do: Work at the annual OC Fair or at events held year-round at the fairgrounds, in indoor or outdoor jobs.
deadline_text: No hiring dates posted on the jobs page for 2027.

what_you_do: You help a local library branch. Tasks include organizing materials and taking part in library events. Shifts are flexible. They include weekdays and weekends.
deadline_text: No deadline. Openings are limited and depend on each branch.

what_you_do: You can get help with tutoring and career exploration. You can get paid or unpaid work experience. Other help includes job skills training, mentoring and college planning. County service providers offer this help.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Start by filling out the interest form.

what_you_do: Join a 4-H club in your county and choose a project from more than 200 options. Teens can keep going in 4-H through the year they turn 19.
deadline_text: Each county sets an enrollment deadline. The state page does not list a date.

what_you_do: Spend eight days at Miami University running a mock state government. Delegates join caucuses and hold elections. They meet Ohio officials. They go to a college fair. It has 50+ colleges and service academies.
deadline_text: Session dates and deadlines are not posted on the pages read. Legion post interviews are usually held in winter or spring at high schools.

what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter in a school career-technical program. You build business skills. Chapters compete at the Ohio state conference in Columbus.
deadline_text: The Ohio DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 at the Greater Columbus Convention Center. No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Hands-on one-day camps and a weeklong camp in summer. They show you jobs in food science, crops, farm tech, food making, animal care and more. Fall 2026 includes a Columbus day on Oct. 21.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 one-day camps: Wilmington Oct. 13, Columbus Oct. 21, Findlay Nov. 3, COLT Lineman Training (Mount Gilead) Oct. 23, Meat Processing (Yorkshire) Oct. 27. Registration closes 10 days before each event, so the Columbus day closes about Oct. 11, 2026.

what_you_do: Join FFA at a school that has an Ohio FFA chapter. Members build leadership and career skills in agriculture and take part in Career Development Events.
deadline_text: Membership opens each August through FFA.org. Ohio FFA lists September 30, 2026 for students in Fall CDEs and November 30, 2026 for all chapters.

what_you_do: Week-long day camps with lab work: DNA and water testing, robot building and programming, field trips and a cardboard boat race. Two camps are for high schoolers (Science Adventurers and Horizons of Science).
deadline_text: 2026 camps ran June 22 to 26, 2026 and registration closed May 31, 2026 or earlier if full. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Serve as a welcoming host for about two weeks at the Ohio State Fair: welcome guests at fair events, and meet people for networking. Housing and meals are provided.
deadline_text: The page says the online application portal opens January 1 and the application is due March 1. Notices come early to mid March, interviews mid to late March, selection early April. No year is shown, so confirm the 2027 dates in January.

what_you_do: Teens choose one or both of two paths. Restoration Ecology has more field work. Conservation Education means talking with visitors. It is at a wildlife conservation center.
deadline_text: No deadline or dates are posted on the volunteer page. The visitor season runs May through October for adult volunteers.

what_you_do: Join a year-round cadet squadron. You learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Cadets wear uniforms and learn drill. They earn promotions and plan their own activities.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: Join a school or YMCA delegation. Prepare in the fall. Then take part in a student-run model government at the spring State Assembly in Columbus. High school roles include legislator, court, lobbyist and media.
deadline_text: Last cycle: State Assembly February 12 to 14, 2026 at the Hyatt Regency Columbus. Registration closed November 28, 2025, with late registration December 1 to 10, 2025. 2027 dates are not posted on the page read.

what_you_do: Tutor 4 to 5 kindergarten to 3rd grade students in math using the OneInMath lessons. The program is run with libraries. You earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register to volunteer on the site.

what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes electrical line work. It includes collision repair and cement masonry. Nurse assistant is another. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: Learn how new tech is changing children's health care. You get mentors, journal clubs, hands-on workshops and field trips. Interns under 18 do morning and afternoon programs. Shadowing in hospital rotations is for ages 18 and up.
deadline_text: The 2026 round is over. The page says next year's application opens in February 2027. For 2026 it opened Feb 1 and closed Feb 28, with rolling interviews.

what_you_do: Girls in grades 9 to 12 get up to 40 hours of job training. Then 11th grade girls do a four-week externship at a local company with a mentor.
deadline_text: Student sign-up dates are not on the page. The 2026 host company sign-up deadline was Mar 26, 2026 (per the 2026 host flyer).

what_you_do: Take college classes while in high school. Dual enrollment classes are taught at partner high schools during the school day. Concurrent classes are on the Golden West campus or online.
deadline_text: The page was taking Fall 2026 forms. Registration for high school students started June 4, 2026. Check the page for each new term.

what_you_do: Work with museum staff to learn about museums, art and curating. The group builds an exhibition from start to finish that opens to the public.
deadline_text: Application dates for the next group are not on the museum pages read.

what_you_do: Help at the main library. You check shelves, get old books ready for the Friends book sale, keep displays full and set up for events.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Volunteer in county parks as a historic docent or in backcountry patrol. Other roles include OC Zoo chances. Training includes first aid and CPR.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up any time.

what_you_do: Represent your school district at the county level. Push for student voice in career classes (CTE). Meet industry mentors. Lead a year-long Impact Project to fix a real need in your school or community.
deadline_text: The page says students apply in spring. Exact dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Learn basic fire skills in a 10 week trainee academy. Then join cadet activities. These include hydrant care and crowd and traffic control at Fire Authority events. You also help with public information programs. Cadets can observe the ride-along program.
deadline_text: The trainee academy is held once a year. The page does not list the next start date.

what_you_do: High school students take college classes for free, transferable credit. Classes are at the high school, at Santa Ana College, on weekends or online.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on this page.

what_you_do: High school students take college classes for free, transferable credit. Classes can be at the high school, at SCC, on weekends or online.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. See the Important Dates link on the page.

what_you_do: A four-week summer art program on campus for high school students. Pick a specialty and a drawing studio. Earn college credit. Show your work in a final show. Housing is available.
deadline_text: Registration begins Nov 16, 2026. Scholarship application deadline is April 16, 2027 (no exceptions); the registration deadline is listed as not set yet. Info sessions on Zoom: Tue Feb 9 6:00 PM and Thu Mar 18 12:00 PM (2027).

what_you_do: You can find paid summer internships and after-school internships for Oakland Unified high school students. The district lists them by employer, with dates and pay. Your pathway teachers can also connect you to internships.
deadline_text: The district updates its summer internship list weekly from January to May. The page still shows Summer 2024 forms; 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: You can get help with career pathways, internships and job placement. You can also take dual enrollment with Peralta Colleges. Dual enrollment means college classes while in high school. The office also processes work permits for Oakland Unified students.
deadline_text: Ongoing; talk to your school's pathway or career counselor. No dates posted.

what_you_do: A four-week summer program for high school students in the Northeast San Fernando Valley. Students earn community service hours.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The next window is not posted. Follow @pbyes_ on Instagram for updates.

what_you_do: Six weeks of classes and field work in the community. There is one class day and one field day a week. Graduates can earn a California Naturalist Certification and 4 college units that can transfer.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2027 window is not posted. Follow @pbyes_ on Instagram for updates.

what_you_do: Do 2 hour summer service projects, help in Member Services or review books for credit. Or join the Teen Advisory Board. It meets monthly in the school year.
deadline_text: Teen Advisory Board applications are available August 1 to 31. Book review hours count for reviews submitted September 1, 2026 to May 15, 2027.

what_you_do: Help art teachers run kids' and teen summer art camps for at least one week, in a morning or afternoon session. You manage the classroom, encourage campers and prep art supplies.
deadline_text: CIT and Lead CIT registration opens Feb 4, 2027 with Enjoy! summer camp registration. No closing date stated.

what_you_do: Teens in grades 8 to 12 volunteer with the library. They join the advisory board. Each semester you pick an activity. Examples include planning a teen program, helping at an outreach event or writing a booklist.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed. The page says to check back in December 2026 to apply for Winter/Spring 2027.

what_you_do: You can join a group of 15 to 20 high school students who plan and lead events for teens in Palo Alto.
deadline_text: The page mentions a deadline but gives no date or year. The only dates found were in a 2023 city article.

what_you_do: High school students serve as youth ambassadors. The council has 15 to 20 students. They speak to the Palo Alto City Council. Topics include mental health, civic engagement and community events.
deadline_text: The page says the application opens July 2027. No closing date stated.

what_you_do: Take college classes for credit while in school. Dual enrollment classes happen at partner schools in the school day. Students at other schools can use concurrent enrollment with a counselor and parent signature.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Forms are processed in 2 to 3 weeks. Summer 2026 ran 6/22 to 8/14/26.

what_you_do: Help at the animal shelter. You might work with animals, foster care or community programs. You can also help with on-site support, office help and humane education. Younger teens can be Ambassadors who guide visitors around the kennels.
deadline_text: Virtual orientations are Tuesday Oct 13 and Tuesday Nov 10, 5:00 to 6:15 p.m. The page does not state the year.

what_you_do: Send in poems, short stories, book reviews, art or photos for a youth magazine for the whole city. You can also offer to help with the magazine. Use the library's teen volunteer application.
deadline_text: No submission deadline is stated on the page.

what_you_do: You can explore careers online through videos, assessments and virtual chats with professionals. Your school has to license Pathful for you to use it.
deadline_text: Depends on your school.

what_you_do: Join a local club and complete hands-on projects. Areas include health, science, agriculture and civic engagement. Older members can take on leadership roles.
deadline_text: No deadline posted; join through your county 4-H office.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron for weekly meetings. Learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. Wear a uniform. Move up in rank as you take on more leadership.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time by visiting a squadron.

what_you_do: Join a business student group at your school. You compete in business events, go to region and state conferences and build leadership skills.
deadline_text: Join through your chapter adviser any time. Next State Leadership Conference: April 12 to 14, 2027.

what_you_do: Join an FFA chapter at your school through agricultural education. Take part in leadership and career events, and do a hands-on project called a Supervised Agricultural Experience.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You join through your school's agricultural education program.

what_you_do: Do your own science research project, then give a 10 minute talk to judges at a regional meet. Students who qualify go on to the State Meet in May.
deadline_text: The 2026 State Meet was May 17 to 19, 2026 at Penn State University Park. Each region sets its own deadlines. The pages read do not list 2027 dates.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend state called Keystone. You run for office and debate bills.
deadline_text: The application page lists a 2025 registration date and the 2026 session dates (June 14 to June 20, 2026). No 2027 dates are posted on the page read.

what_you_do: Spend a week in a pretend government. You live in a mock city and county, hold mock offices, hold meetings and learn how Pennsylvania government works.
deadline_text: The home page lists a 2027 application and the dates 20-25 June 2026. The only deadline posted is old (May 20, 2023). No 2027 deadline is stated.

what_you_do: Join a small crew in state parks and forests for six weeks. You build trails, protect habitats and improve park spaces, with adult mentors.
deadline_text: 2026 dates were June 29 to August 7, 2026. No 2027 dates or deadline are posted on the page read.

what_you_do: Take free college classes while in high school, on a Peralta campus or through classes arranged with your school. Courses go on your permanent college transcript.
deadline_text: No deadlines posted. Register each term.

what_you_do: You get a paid 6-week summer job. The job is with Prince George's County Government or a county partner. You get job readiness training and career exploration.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications Mar 1 to Mar 31, 2026; program Jul 6 to Aug 14, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: You can volunteer at a Summer Playtime program at age 14. Or volunteer at a Summer Day Camp at age 15. You work 12 to 15 hours a week. You earn student service learning hours.
deadline_text: Volunteer applications are accepted online from March 1-May 1. The page gives no year.

what_you_do: You join about 20 high school youth. You advise the parks department. You plan teen events and community service projects. You join leadership conferences and field trips.
deadline_text: No application deadline stated.

what_you_do: Help at a branch as a library, computer, facility or program aide. Or earn up to 6 service hours through VolunTEEN. Teens over the age of 15 can help in the Kids Achieve Club homework program.
deadline_text: No deadline. Kids Achieve Club interviews: June for September programs, November for January programs.

what_you_do: You can help in collections departments and the Patrick Center lab. You can help with Bird Safe Philly, a bird-collision program. You can also help with Nature at Noon walks. Roles vary. Not all are open to teens.
deadline_text: No deadline listed.

what_you_do: Join the Teen Sketch art program at the museum. Or work with other teens on the museum's Teen Podcast as a writer, researcher, host or producer.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 programs are listed with Apply links. No closing date is posted on the page.

what_you_do: Train to be a camp counselor in training. You learn to lead groups, handle conflict and camp outdoors. You also practice writing a resume and job interviews. You get American Red Cross First Aid and CPR.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 session ran June 15 to 26, 2026 and was sold out. The camp FAQ says Summer 2027 registration opens Monday, Feb. 1, 2027 at 9 am; OWLS 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Work paid, part-time shifts on one of three teams. ROOTS Tree Crew cares for trees. Earth Seeds Ecology covers gardening and nature jobs. Sankofa Community Farm grows food.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 cycle closed Sept 23, 2025 (program started Oct 6, 2025). The page says applications reopen in August for the 2026-27 school year, but still shows the 2025 dates.

what_you_do: This is a paid summer internship at an arts and culture group in Philadelphia. You get training in work skills. You get mentoring. You also go to sessions on college and career readiness.
deadline_text: The page posts no intern application dates. Its only application notice is for worksite hosts: Summer 2026 applications are officially closed.

what_you_do: The City funds this program. It includes paid service learning, project-based learning and internships. You learn about careers and get mentoring. You build work skills and shadow workers on the job.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. FAQ: summer applications open between March and April each year.

what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron any time.

what_you_do: This is a 10-day commuter camp. It has lectures and lab experiences. The topics are current topics in neuroscience.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was April 3, 2026. The page says 2027 Summer Institutes information will be posted this winter.

what_you_do: Drop in after school for free art workshops (cyanotype photography, papermaking, book arts) and free studio days. Snacks and bus passes are provided.
deadline_text: Teen Lounge 2026-2027 runs during the school year. Fall workshops started Tuesday, Sept 8, 2026. It is drop in.

what_you_do: Take an 11 week laboratory research training course on Saturdays at Fox Chase (about 30 lab hours), then present your results on week 11. The program says it is nearly all cost free for students.
deadline_text: The application launches in mid to late October each year and stays open about 3.5 weeks. The exact 2026 dates are not posted on the page read. Interviews are in early to mid December and letters go out by email before December 31.

what_you_do: Join one of three Saturday morning workshops: Robotics, Science in the City, or Science Investigators. They have career talks, mentoring and field trips. High school Franklin Ambassadors join each workshop to help the students.
deadline_text: The page has an Apply link but no dates for the current year.

what_you_do: This is a free four-year STEM program. It starts in 9th grade. Each year has STEM programming. Rising seniors are paid for a 10-week lab research experience.
deadline_text: Applications for the next freshman cohort are currently closed; check back for the 2027 class. FAQ says applications usually open late September or early October and are due mid-December.

what_you_do: Learn about the Delaware River, caring for nature, STEM and local history. Then share what you learn with visitors on the museum floor. Ambassadors also build speaking and teamwork skills.
deadline_text: The page says apply by April 20 (priority interviews); its flyer link is dated March 2026. Next dates not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital unit one day a week for eight summer weeks. Each day is four hours. You get an orientation and on-the-job training first.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates and no year. The 2024 packet said applications are accepted from February until April.

what_you_do: Train for a career at no cost and work toward a high school diploma or equivalent. The center provides transportation. Training includes certified nurse assistant, clinical medical assistant, culinary arts, emergency medical technician, and more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: Work full time for eight weeks on a research project with a Monell scientist. The program is described as paid, and apprentices cannot work more than 35 hours a week.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the Summer 2027 program will open in October 2026. The deadline is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Take part in an art program that meets twice a week at a high school site, in school or after school. The page says students can go on to apply for scholarships, internships and jobs in the creative field.
deadline_text: Rolling admission is open. The page says the fall session begins in late September 2026.

what_you_do: Spend six weeks learning to act as a person from history, in costume. You focus on the lives of people of African descent in the time of the Revolution. You go on field trips and do museum career workshops. It ends with a public Interpretation Day.
deadline_text: The page names a 2026 session but gives no application dates. The 2026 program is finished and no 2027 dates are posted.

what_you_do: Meet weekly after school at PAFA to make art and talk about it. You plan events for teens at the museum, work with staff and help with a teen art magazine.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 starts Oct 21, 2026; Spring 2027 starts Jan 27, 2027. No closing date is posted.

what_you_do: You train for free. You earn Red Cross lifeguard certification. Then you work as a lifeguard at a city pool through the summer.
deadline_text: Free training is offered year-round; reserve a slot on Eventbrite.

what_you_do: You can work at recreation centers, playgrounds and Playstreets. You can also work on special initiatives. You help younger children. You build communication and leadership skills.
deadline_text: The page still says registration closed for the C2L-PHL Summer 2025 program. No 2026 or 2027 dates posted.

what_you_do: Spend four weeks on Penn's campus. Pair up with one of five Penn graduate and professional schools to see careers up close. Get lessons on financial literacy, study skills, time management, SAT prep and personal statements. It usually ends with a college fair.
deadline_text: The page says the Summer Mentorship Program for 2027 will begin taking applications in January 2027. The deadline is not posted yet.

what_you_do: Summer Academies (2 or 3 weeks, non-credit, residential), Pre-College (residential or online, for credit) and Online Seminars on topics like biomedical research, economics, forensic science and neuroscience.
deadline_text: 2026: May 1 for Academies and Pre-College Residential/Online Session I; June 1 for Online Seminars and Pre-College Online Session II. Rolling admissions. 2027 dates not posted.

what_you_do: Learn about police work. You get mentoring, classroom lessons and hands-on drills. You meet every Saturday at the Police Academy. Cadets also help at parades, runs and city events.
deadline_text: The program site says applications are open for 2026-2027. No closing date is posted.

what_you_do: Go to a supervised after-school program. It has homework help and career workshops. It also has activities for leadership and life skills.
deadline_text: The page says enrollment is open all year round.

what_you_do: Meet three days a week after school for two hour sessions. You build job skills, earn credentials that employers know, visit workplaces and meet people who work in the field. Members get first pick for paid PYN internships.
deadline_text: The page says it is recruiting at high schools across Philadelphia. No closing date posted.

what_you_do: This is paid work-based learning. It includes classroom training in professional skills. You get mentoring and career coaching. Rising juniors and seniors do about 100 hours at a paid worksite in the city.
deadline_text: Summer cohort applications open early March; Fall/Winter cohort open early August; Winter/Spring cohort open in November. Page says Now Recruiting for Summer + Fall 2026.

what_you_do: Meet employers, schools, training programs and workforce groups in one place. Ask about first jobs, internships, career training and college paths.
deadline_text: Friday, October 23, 2026, 3:00 to 7:00 pm. Pre-registration deadline is Oct 15. The page says registration is not required to attend.

what_you_do: Career programs in over 43 occupational areas (healthcare, IT, culinary, construction and more), a three-year course of study with work-based learning such as internships and apprenticeships.
deadline_text: Follow the School Selection timeline for middle schoolers; high schoolers ask their counselor.

what_you_do: You volunteer as a counselor-in-training. You work with the Camp Schuylkill nature day camp. You help lead younger campers.
deadline_text: 2026 deadline was March 31, 2026. Camp Schuylkill runs on a weekly schedule from June 21 to August 13, 2027.

what_you_do: You support the wildlife clinic. The clinic treats injured and orphaned wild animals. Clinic Support is for ages 16 and up. Animal Care requires age 18.
deadline_text: 2026 in-person info sessions were February 7 and February 28; virtual sessions as needed. Fill out the application to hear about future sessions.

what_you_do: Take one real college course for credit and two non-credit workshops in a four-week program on Temple campus, with study hour led by Temple student mentors. You can choose to live on campus.
deadline_text: The page says registration for Summer 2027 begins in December. No closing date was readable.

what_you_do: Free college prep all year. There is tutoring after school on weekdays, Saturday classes, college visits and a six-week summer program on campus. One track focuses on civic work and one on STEM.
deadline_text: Rolling applications. The page says the Summer Academy deadline is May 31.

what_you_do: Take one 3 credit college course with Villanova faculty and a 1 credit College Pathways course. It is a four-week summer program on campus. You can earn four college credits.
deadline_text: Applications for 2027 are open now. No closing date is posted. The page says 2027 dates are being finalized, with classes expected in July, and it encourages early applications.

what_you_do: Spend four weeks at the Wistar Institute (3601 Spruce Street) learning biomedical research, with 15 students in the program. Students attend Monday to Thursday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
deadline_text: The 2026 program has ended. The page says to check back in January for the 2027 summer program. Last year's cycle had interviews in April and decisions in the first week of May.

what_you_do: Do 6 to 12 weeks of career training and paid work at partner sites around the city. You get job coaching, money lessons and resume workshops. You also go on tours of workplaces.
deadline_text: No closing date posted. The page still lists 2025 summer jobs, so check PYN for new openings.

what_you_do: Work a paid placement of 6 to 12 weeks at a partner group. You get mentoring, career coaching and support services that help prevent violence. The program aims to serve about 400 young people.
deadline_text: No closing date posted.

what_you_do: Talk with a Youth Navigator at a PA CareerLink center. You can find job and training programs, first-job help and career resources for Philadelphia youth. The page also links to work permit help for ages 14 to 17.
deadline_text: Year-round help. Programs have their own dates.

what_you_do: Advise the Mayor, City Council and schools on issues that affect young people. Review laws. Run youth-led events and public service programs. You work in committees on education, public safety, health and recreation, and jobs and money.
deadline_text: No application dates on the current page. The 2021 announcement said applications were reviewed on a rolling basis.

what_you_do: Teach zoo guests about animals and conservation. You use games and hands-on activities. You build public speaking, leadership and time management skills.
deadline_text: The page says to stay tuned for details about the next recruitment period; no dates listed.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a major Atlanta hospital over eight summer weeks. You work at least one weekday shift a week for at least six of the eight weeks and explore health careers.
deadline_text: Application period Feb 26 to Mar 12, 2027. Mandatory orientation Monday June 7, 2027. Up to 30 teens accepted.

what_you_do: Help with library programs and special projects. Middle schoolers can join Adopt-a-Shelf. They help keep teen spaces and collections neat. They also advise on new purchases.
deadline_text: Adopt-a-Shelf: the Session 1 application period has ended; Session 2 applications open November 2 (year not stated on the page). High school volunteers attend an orientation session; check the library calendar for dates.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital or health center. Canonsburg roles listed include patient activity cart rounding, helping in the Serenity Room, handwashing observation and fall purposeful rounding.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page.

what_you_do: Guard county wave pools and swimming pools during the summer season. Work flexible hours including weekends and holidays.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Your application packet must be on file before you can take a certification class or aquatics test.

what_you_do: Help staff lead summer nature day camps for kids ages 5 to 12. Start with a one-day, four-hour training. Service is 30 hours during the June and July day camps.
deadline_text: 2026 training was June 11, 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. at Beechwood Farms Nature Reserve. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Get hands-on experiences, mentors and a look at real careers in several industries. Join councils and internship pathways. Get help with resumes and interview prep through the Career Works High program.
deadline_text: No dates are posted on the page.

what_you_do: Help museum staff and camp educators. You help with learning activities that support campers. The camps are run by three groups. They are the Carnegie Museum of Natural History, the Carnegie Museum of Art and Powdermill Nature Reserve.
deadline_text: The Natural History form says the application period has closed and to check back in early 2027 for the next cycle. Dates for the next cycle are not posted.

what_you_do: Guard City of Pittsburgh pools as a part-time seasonal lifeguard. Shifts include evenings, weekends and holidays.
deadline_text: The 2026 posting opened Feb 7, 2026 and closed Aug 3, 2026. The 2027 posting is not up yet.

what_you_do: Go to weekly squadron meetings of the Civil Air Patrol. Cadets across the country learn leadership. They also learn aerospace, fitness and character. They do things like flying, contests and summer encampments. There is also a Cyber and STEM Badge Program.
deadline_text: No deadline. Contact the squadron any time.

what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on the CMU campus. You learn computer science through classes and group projects. You hear faculty lectures and visit tech companies. All costs are covered.
deadline_text: The CMU pages list a February 1, 2027 deadline (decisions April 1, 2027) but do not say when applications open or whether they are open now. Check the CMU Pre-College page before you plan around it.

what_you_do: Live on or commute to the CMU campus for 3 to 6 weeks. Study architecture, art, design, drama or music. Also study computational biology or writing. You can also study culture. Pick the National High School Game Academy or college summer courses.
deadline_text: The CMU pages list a scholarship deadline of February 1, 2027 and a basic application deadline of March 1, 2027, but do not say when applications open or whether they are open now. Check the CMU Pre-College page before you plan around it.

what_you_do: Six weeks on the CMU campus taking math and science courses, doing a STEM research project, and getting college application help. Fully funded and merit based.
deadline_text: The CMU pages list a February 1, 2027 deadline (decisions April 1, 2027) but do not say when applications open or whether they are open now. Check the CMU Pre-College page before you plan around it.

what_you_do: One-day campus visit for high school students curious about pharmacy. Try a SimMan patient simulator, pharmacy compounding and an emergency medicine scenario, then take a campus tour.
deadline_text: 2027 dates: June 14, 15, 16, 24 and 25, 2027. No registration deadline is posted.

what_you_do: After-school glass art classes for grades 9 to 12 in glassblowing, flameworking and kilnforming. Beginner classes meet once a week for 10 weeks. Advanced classes meet for 12 weeks.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page. Use Register Now for current classes.

what_you_do: Work on an urban farm from seed to harvest: plant, weed, mulch and harvest. You also join food system workshops, cook with farm produce and run a farm stand.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 2 to June 5, 2026 and are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Live on campus. You train for a career at no cost. You also earn a high school diploma or equivalent. Training includes highway construction. It includes cement masonry. Phlebotomy is another. So is clinical medical assistant. There are more.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. You start by making a MyJobCorps account on the Job Corps website.

what_you_do: Greet visitors, help with exhibit demos and support science programs. Full training is provided. No science background is needed.
deadline_text: Summer Teen Program: applications open in January, deadline March 1. School Year Teen Program: applications June 1 to August 1 only. Both were closed on the day this page was read; the posted pattern is by month, with no year.

what_you_do: Take a guided tour of a real STEM workplace, talk with STEM professionals and try a hands-on activity. 2026 stops included a manufacturing lab, a CMU materials lab, Bidwell Training Center and a power station.
deadline_text: 2026 tours ran July 8 to Sept 20, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: After-school program with lessons on job prep and mock interviews, public speaking, financial literacy, college and trade school planning, life skills, art and field trips.
deadline_text: No dates or deadline posted. The page does not state a current start date.

what_you_do: Work a paid summer job at a local business, nonprofit or community group. You get coaching on workplace skills and career paths.
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran March 2 to June 5, 2026 and are closed. The page says applications are accepted in the spring; 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Meet with Make-A-Wish staff and learn how nonprofits work. The groups support granting wishes for children with critical illnesses. In-person members attend monthly meetings.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Meeting days are set by the group at its first meeting.

what_you_do: Meet weekly at the museum to meet artists. You take field trips to local art spaces and learn about creative jobs. You also plan a public event made by teens for teens.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 call closed Sept 15, 2025 and the first session was Oct 9, 2025. The 2026-27 call was not found on the page.

what_you_do: You help run bird shows and lorikeet feedings. You help at summer camp. You lead education cart activities. You prepare enrichment for the birds. Staff mentor you each day.
deadline_text: The 2026 application period has closed. For 2026 the group interviews were April 11 and April 18, 2026 and the orientation was May 30, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Five-week outdoor program in Frick Park with research and restoration work in the park. The program also has an overnight team-building retreat in the Laurel Highlands.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: applications opened March 2 and closed May 8, 2026. Interviews with the student and a parent ran April 20 to May 15. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Take a seven-week course at Phipps. Topics are climate change, energy, pollution, food, environmental justice and green careers. It has classes, workshops and service projects. It ends with a Youth Garden Summit.
deadline_text: The 2026 group is closed. The page offers a form to be told when the next group opens. The 2026 classes ran mid June to late July.

what_you_do: Help camp instructors design and prepare crafts. Work with children ages 2 to 12. Clean up after daily activities at Phipps summer camps.
deadline_text: The volunteer page says applications are due Thursday, October 22, 2026, but that line sits in a different volunteer section and the page does not say it covers teen volunteers. No teen deadline is posted, so ask Phipps. Camps run June to August.

what_you_do: Spend weekdays in a Pitt lab working on a current research project with other high school students, with Pitt faculty nearby for help. Weekly sessions cover applying to college.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 applications open in spring 2027 and are due at the end of March, with interviews in April and acceptance notices by mid May. The exact due date is not posted yet.

what_you_do: This is a four week summer program at Pitt Public Health. It has talks and panels on public health careers. It has a team research project and a poster symposium. It also has field trips. You are matched with a Pitt faculty mentor.
deadline_text: The 2026 application ran Feb 4 to March 14, 2026, and is closed. The 2027 dates are not posted yet. Expect a similar winter to March window.

what_you_do: A week on campus learning about accounting jobs. You tour local firms that do accounting. You practice interviews, meeting people, public speaking and college planning.
deadline_text: The 2026 program ran July 26 to 31, 2026. The page listed no application deadline. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A week of crime scene work. You work a crime scene house and study fingerprints and hair clues with lab staff. You also tour the Allegheny County Medical Examiner and Jail.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran July 20 to 24 and July 27 to 31. No registration deadline was listed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Three days of hands-on workshops and mentoring. You come up with a startup idea, work on product design and customer research, practice public speaking and give a closing pitch.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 29 to July 1, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted. No registration deadline was listed.

what_you_do: Three days of learning about jobs in sports business. People who work for local teams like the Pirates, Penguins, Steelers and Riverhounds teach you. Each day has a behind-the-scenes tour of a sports site.
deadline_text: The 2026 camp ran June 29 to July 1, 2026 and was full with a waitlist. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Join a 10-person crew for a summer of paid conservation work.
deadline_text: The page says there are no current openings and to check back. Past summers ran from the last week of June to the first week of August.

what_you_do: You volunteer one shift a week. The shift is in an approved area of the children's hospital. Examples are the sibling center or therapy gym. Hospital staff supervise you.
deadline_text: The hospital is not accepting new teen applications for this calendar year and says to check back in early January for next year's process.

what_you_do: Join a mentored research team in a lab. There are nine research sites at Pitt and UPMC. It runs for about seven weeks in the summer. Topics include cancer biology, computer science and biomedical informatics.
deadline_text: Application window: December 3, 2026 to February 14, 2027.

what_you_do: Learn to DJ in a free 12-week workshop led by professional DJs. You use pro gear, make your own mixes and perform live at events like Youth Invasion and the LGBTQ+ Prom.
deadline_text: The Warhol page says applications are now closed. Next dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Go behind the scenes at the museum. Meet professional artists. Learn silkscreen printing. Plan teen events such as Youth Invasion.
deadline_text: The application deadline was Friday, October 9, 2026. Weekly meetings start October 15, 2026.

what_you_do: You volunteer one day a week at the zoo. You handle and care for ambassador animals. You guide guests at exhibits. You run touch tables and animal talks.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 program open December 15, 2026 and stay open through mid-January 2027. The exact closing date is not posted.

what_you_do: Meet about twice a month at the zoo. You talk about conservation, hear from experts, take behind-the-scenes tours and go on field trips. Teens also help with projects like pulling invasive plants in local parks.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 season were due Aug 1, 2026 and are closed. Next season is not posted.

what_you_do: You do a paid youth internship at an urban farm and nursery. You learn sustainable farming, food distribution and school gardens. You get job training. You get food safety certifications. Community mentors help you.
deadline_text: Not posted

what_you_do: Be a volunteer docent at Pleasant Home, a National Historic Landmark. You share its history and building style with visitors. You help make their visit one to remember.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Students are appointed to a city commission. They give the City Council advice. They give feedback on community issues that affect young people.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 recruitment: apply by 5:00 PM on Tuesday, August 18, 2026. That deadline has passed. The next recruitment date is not posted.

what_you_do: You go to training classes and monthly meetings. You finish a required 9 week Police Cadet Academy on Sundays. You do at least 10 volunteer hours a month in community service.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. A recruiter contacts you after you send the application.
