what_you_do: Spend a week at Texas Lutheran University in a pretend 51st state. You set up your own city, county and state governments and take a trip to the State Capitol.
deadline_text: 2027 dates are not posted. In 2026, units could reserve spots Feb 1 to May 1 and schools Feb 15 to May 1. The page says spots fill fast, so act quickly.

what_you_do: Live on the Eagle Lake campus in a free residential program for teens who are disengaged from school. After the on-campus phase there is a follow-up phase with a mentor.
deadline_text: Classes start in January and July. The application cutoff is normally at least 30 days before class starts.

what_you_do: This is four weeks of full-day volunteering at a children's hospital. You take three to four assignments a day. Examples are a tea cart, craft cart, library, physical therapy and supply chain. You also get a lunch and learn.
deadline_text: The 2026 application opened Monday Feb 9 and closed Friday Feb 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to build business and marketing skills. Take part in DECA programs and contests. Texas DECA runs a yearly state career development conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston.

what_you_do: Take an agricultural science class at school and join your local FFA chapter. FFA is a student-led leadership group. Members earn degrees and can join contests, speaking events and leadership programs.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

what_you_do: Join a HOSA chapter at your school to explore health careers. Texas HOSA runs a state leadership conference each year. Membership comes through school chapters.
deadline_text: No membership deadlines or conference dates are on the pages read. Ask your advisor for dates.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a Texas state park. Jobs include special events, gift shop and office help, trail and grounds work, plant restoration, and leading tours and nature programs.
deadline_text: Apply any time. Openings are listed in the online portal.

what_you_do: Spend part of the summer on campus in a hands-on chemistry research training program. Up to 20 students learn lab skills, see research demos and prepare for chemistry research in high school.
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens Jan 19, 2027. No closing date is posted. In 2026, students were notified April 24, 2026.

what_you_do: Get a paid summer job placement of at least five weeks. You earn a paycheck while learning new skills and gaining work experience.
deadline_text: No dates for summer 2027 are posted on the pages read. It is a summer program. Ask your local office in the fall or winter.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aerospace and STEM, fitness and character. Cadets can go to summer and winter encampments. They can take part in real Civil Air Patrol missions.
deadline_text: Join any time. Attend three squadron meetings first.

what_you_do: This Evanston group links students to local firms and to job training. You learn skilled trades. Trades include plumbing, HVAC and automotive. Others are electrical, aviation and manufacturing. Students meet business owners. The owners can help start careers.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: You get paid summer work experience at a host site. There are more than 80 host sites. They are businesses, nonprofits and government offices. You first complete a required job readiness training.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed and the page is labeled Expired. 2027 dates are not posted; the county has a 2027 interest form to get notified when applications open.

what_you_do: Sign up for tree planting and other volunteer events. They are listed on the TreePeople events calendar.
deadline_text: Sign up for each event on the Events Calendar. No program deadline.

what_you_do: Do paid green jobs with Trees Atlanta staff to get hands-on experience. Weekly sessions teach job-search skills and money basics.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: opened Nov 15, 2025, closed Feb 2, 2026, job ran June 1 to July 17, 2026. The page says 2027 details are coming later.

what_you_do: You can take free career classes through your high school. Your high school is in Dublin, Livermore or Pleasanton. There are 30 or more courses. They cover about 10 career areas. Examples are building trades, health science, IT and public services.
deadline_text: Registration for the 2026-2027 school year is closed. Talk to your school's College and Career Specialist or counselor.

what_you_do: You can get skills building, leadership training and paid internships with Trybe, an East Bay youth program. The City's summer jobs list shows that Trybe offers a 100 hour summer job for East Oakland youth.
deadline_text: No current dates posted. The old 2022 posting took applications until May 31.

what_you_do: Meet monthly, September to April, with city leaders. Explore civic issues, serve as ambassadors for peers, and learn how local government works. Members commit to a full year term.
deadline_text: The 2026 council application closed Aug 19, 2026. Meetings: 9/16, 10/21, 11/18, 1/20, 2/24, 3/17, 4/21, with optional dinner 4/26 and celebration 5/7. The next application is not posted.

what_you_do: Debate and speech camps at Augsburg. They cover policy, Lincoln-Douglas, Congress, Public Forum and speech. There is also a workshop on speaking up for a community issue.
deadline_text: 2026 early bird ended March 29; scholarship priority deadline March 1 and last call May 10, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Teams build a made-up product and business plan, then pitch it Shark Tank style at the end of the week. Includes speakers, mock interviews and breakouts.
deadline_text: MBV 2027 dates are not posted yet. The site says to check back.

what_you_do: Shadow a team that helps put on a show, such as stage management, lights or sound. You learn how a show is made.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers help visitors connect with Como's animals and plants and learn to care about nature. The program also builds work experience and job skills.
deadline_text: The page says applications are no longer being accepted for this summer. Next dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Learn about nature and caring for natural areas. Build outdoor skills. Finish community projects with a crew led by young adults. You are based at a nature center or park in the Twin Cities area.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted for summer 2027. The page lists 2026 home bases only.

what_you_do: Teens start with a 90 day work readiness internship, then can interview for the paid Bakery Program, where you earn while you learn. Cart Captains get a raise.
deadline_text: The page says applications are always accepted. Session dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A four day summer design camp at Dunwoody for high school students. It includes lunch, supplies and a field trip.
deadline_text: 2026 registration closed July 13, 2026. The page says summer 2027 details are expected in January or February 2027.

what_you_do: Juniors and seniors join monthly workshops and a 3 week summer experience. It has job site visits, hands-on projects and mentoring. Students who enroll at Dunwoody can get a scholarship.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 applications are closed (the deadline was April 19). The next application opens in early fall; no date posted. Online info sessions Oct 8, Nov 5, Dec 3, 2026 and Jan 7, Feb 4, Mar 4, Apr 8, 2027 (RSVP required).

what_you_do: Students finish 8 weeks of summer training in IT, business and work skills. Then they work a paid, year-long internship at a partner company. They get college and career coaching.
deadline_text: No date is posted. Students apply in fall or winter of junior year and the process finishes in the spring.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers work one weekday shift a week at the children's hospital in downtown Saint Paul. They work on their own. They are at ease around patients with disabilities and complex medical needs.
deadline_text: The page says applications for summer 2026 are closed. Dates for summer 2027 are not posted.

what_you_do: Join a five year STEM program. It has summer camp at the University of Minnesota and YWCA Midtown, plus school year support. You explore STEM careers and meet mentors. In high school you can do a stipend internship.
deadline_text: The 2026 summer dates were June 29 to July 24, 2026 (no camp July 4). The page says registration is currently closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A weeklong day camp. You use light microscopes and Hamline's scanning electron microscope. Then you make microscope images in teams and show them.
deadline_text: Registration opens Monday, Oct 26 (2026, since the camp is in July 2027). Scholarship application due March 30, 2027.

what_you_do: High school volunteers work weekly shifts of two to four hours in HealthPartners hospitals and clinics. You get training in your department first.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The process takes about 3 to 4 weeks.

what_you_do: One on one career coaching, job and resume help, and help applying for partner employers' internships and jobs. Hired does not run internships itself. Also help with a diploma or GED, skills training and life skills.
deadline_text: No deadlines. Staff follow up quickly after you send the referral form.

what_you_do: Young artists work on paid projects for clients in studios. The studios are for graphic design, modern art or environmental design. Working artists, designers and architects train you.
deadline_text: No deadlines are posted.

what_you_do: A 10 week drawing and design course taught by working artists. Finishing one session lets you interview for paid JXTALabs apprenticeships, which start at age 14.
deadline_text: Sessions: fall Sept 16 to Nov 20, 2026 and winter Jan 6 to Mar 12, 2027 (Tue and Thu, 4:00 to 6:30 pm). Summer 2026 ran June 23 to Aug 27.

what_you_do: Teen volunteers serve at M Health Fairview hospitals after an interview, online learning and orientation. Service is about 100 hours. That is roughly 3 to 4 hours a week for 6 to 9 months.
deadline_text: No dates or deadlines are listed.

what_you_do: Do work experiences with the Park Board. They teach work skills, decision making, communication and a good work ethic. Photo captions on the page show crews doing garden, painting and sign install projects.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the 2026 season are closed. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Serve on a youth council. It gives feedback on Park Board programs and processes. Members plan community events and build leadership and research skills. They explore careers. They help guide anti-violence outreach.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the council page.

what_you_do: A one week aviation career camp for high school students in the Minneapolis-Saint Paul area. Each of two sessions is limited to 30 students.
deadline_text: The page says the window is open each year from Feb 1 to April 1. 2027 is not posted yet. Aid decisions come in April.

what_you_do: Two week summer sessions at Macalester College. Each student takes one class per session from nearly 30 offerings (max 16 students per class) and joins daily rec time. You can live in a dorm.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 1, 2027 and are reviewed as they arrive. Aid offers start May 1.

what_you_do: Teens help in the kitchen, on the farms, or on meal deliveries. You work with Open Arms staff after an orientation.
deadline_text: No deadline. Sign up for an orientation.

what_you_do: Teens help with library materials, teen services, children's services or other tasks. Branches include Maplewood, Mounds View, New Brighton, North St. Paul, Roseville, Shoreview and White Bear Lake. Some tasks involve lifting and pushing carts.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: Ten interns spend four weeks exploring STEM careers. There are four field trips, and lunch once a week on trip days.
deadline_text: The 2026 deadline was April 3, 2026, with interviews in mid April. 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: A Red Cross lifeguard course (lifeguarding with deep water, CPR/AED and first aid, valid 2 years). Graduates can be hired as City of Saint Paul lifeguards.
deadline_text: No course dates are posted. Main summer hiring for certified guards runs mid April to June.

what_you_do: A paid 8 week Summer Academy gets you ready to join a city board. The term is two years. Boards include Parks and Recreation, Transportation and Neighborhood Safety.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The page does not give a year for its dates, so treat them as a yearly pattern.

what_you_do: High schoolers work as paid museum employees in a program built to feel like a real workplace. They pick from four STEM areas and get advising, portfolio help, college visits and career fairs.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.

what_you_do: A short paid summer internship on Spark-Y projects around the Twin Cities. Team Lead roles guide interns aged 14 to 18.

deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the Meydenbauer Center in Bellevue.

what_you_do: Spend a week at Warm Beach Conference Center running a mock city, county and state government. You join a party, hold an office, run elections and make laws.
deadline_text: No application deadline is posted. Spaces are limited each year, so apply early. The session is June 20 to 26, 2027.

what_you_do: You can apply to volunteer in hospital roles at Washington Hospital in Fremont. You are a high school student. Openings depend on what the hospital needs.
deadline_text: Next high school round is Fall 2026. The waiting list closed May 22, 2026, but new students can still join and are contacted only when an info session is scheduled.

what_you_do: Volunteer at a library branch to build work-readiness skills. A library staff member contacts you after you apply.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Serve for one week at the State Capitol during the legislative session. You hand out materials and deliver messages. You carry the flags at the start of each day's session. You work on the chamber floor and attend Page School.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2027 session open Nov 1, 2026. No closing date is posted.

what_you_do: Work on a crew of teens with two adult leaders on park projects for four weeks. In week five you camp in a national park and do conservation work there.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions ran June 22 to July 24 and July 28 to Aug 28 (dates subject to change). 2027 dates and deadline not posted.

what_you_do: Join a crew of 8 teens and 2 adult leaders on tree and park projects in city parks, public lands and community gardens. About 32 hours a week of work plus 8 hours of training.
deadline_text: 2026 Washington sessions ran June 22 to July 24 and July 28 to Aug 28 (dates subject to change). 2027 dates and deadline not posted.

what_you_do: 11th and 12th graders take college classes at a Washington community or technical college. They earn high school and college credit.
deadline_text: Deadlines are not stated on the SBCTC page; they vary by college.

what_you_do: Help at your community library with a short project, a regular task or a special event. You go through an orientation and training and commit a regular part of your week.
deadline_text: No deadline. Opportunities vary by branch.

what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aerospace, fitness and character. The Washington Wing lists a cadet competition and a cadet ball. It also lists an encampment. A ground search and rescue academy is listed too.
deadline_text: Join any time through a local squadron.

what_you_do: Youth build and fix hiking trails on one-day work parties and some multi-day trips, with trained crew leaders. Teams of youth can also book a private work party.
deadline_text: No deadline. Choose a work party any time (search the work party page).

what_you_do: Live on campus in Bremerton for about five months in a free program for teens who have dropped out of high school or are at risk of it. You work on getting school credits back and on life skills.
deadline_text: Applications are open for the class that starts Jan 11, 2027. No closing date is posted. Spots go first come, first served.

what_you_do: Free college prep at school. It includes study hall, tutoring, workshops and college visits. You get help with applications. You also explore careers and get internship chances. There is an optional 6 week summer program at the Sugar Grove campus.
deadline_text: The program page does not post a deadline or a school year, and older notes on it pointed to 2024-25. Email upwardbound@waubonsee.edu to ask if applications are open before you apply.

what_you_do: Help with park clean-up, yearly special events, program help and youth sports coaching. Planting flowers and cleaning up debris and leaves are listed park jobs.
deadline_text: No deadline stated.

what_you_do: Help put on events for younger kids, prepare supplies for programs and help shape library services. Teen volunteers earn service hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. You can also stop by the Youth and Teen Department during library hours.

what_you_do: Help run recreation programs and events for people with disabilities. These include games, art, field trips and one-time events. You can volunteer in a seasonal program, at one event or in the office.
deadline_text: Applications are accepted all year. WDSRA keeps your application on file until a fitting role opens.

what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital one weekday shift a week over the summer. Tasks include helping guests, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical or non-clinical departments.
deadline_text: 2026 cycle: application deadline Mar 31, 2026, interviews in March or April, program June 4 to July 29, 2026. The 2027 dates are not posted.

what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. Tasks include customer service, moving patients and helping people find their way. You can work in clinical and non-clinical departments. It is one 2-hour shift a week for 6 of the 8 weeks.
deadline_text: Application window Feb 1 to 15, forms due Feb 28. The page does not print a year, so treat this as the yearly pattern and check for 2027.

what_you_do: Volunteer in a hospital over the summer. You work one two-hour shift each week for six of the eight summer weeks.
deadline_text: Applications open each February, interviews in March, orientation in April. The page does not give a 2027 closing date.

what_you_do: You help staff at city summer camps with set up, clean up, crafts, activities and special events. It is a summer mentoring and volunteer program.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page. Dates for the next summer are not posted.

what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 take West Valley College classes for free. Middle College and on-campus dual enrollment exist for some districts.
deadline_text: No deadline on the page. Follow the college's term dates.

what_you_do: Help in the Digital Creator Lab, run D&D games, shelve books and decorate Teenspace. You also help at programs. The Teen Library Council plans programs and recommends books. Teens help plan a Haunted Activity House for kids and families on October 30.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. School year volunteering begins the week of Monday, September 14 (no year printed; the weekday matches 2026). Haunted House planning meetings start in spring.

what_you_do: Anyone can edit Wikipedia, even without an account. Start with small fixes and use the tutorials.
deadline_text: Always open.

what_you_do: Help with youth programs and prepare program materials. Write book reviews and make social media posts. In summer, work the Summer Reading Club booth or the Studio maker space. You help patrons with arts, crafts and tech.
deadline_text: Applications for school year teen volunteers were open when read (October 2026). Summer 2026 applications closed for the season. 2027 summer dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Eau Claire as a citizen of a mock city and county. Elect city, county and state officials and run the government.
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 13 to 19, 2027 at UW-Eau Claire. No application deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Spend a week at UW-Oshkosh in a hands-on program about how government works. Delegates are young women in their junior year of high school.
deadline_text: The 2027 session is June 20 to 25, 2027 at UW-Oshkosh. No application deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Join a DECA chapter at your school and build business and marketing skills. Chapters compete at the Wisconsin state conference in Lake Geneva.
deadline_text: The Wisconsin DECA conference is February 22 to 24, 2027 in Lake Geneva, WI. No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Join a youth group tied to Wisconsin's citizen conservation panel. You get a mentor. You volunteer with DNR staff, such as on fish and wildlife surveys. You learn how natural resource policy is made.
deadline_text: No deadline. The FAQ says applications are accepted and reviewed on an ongoing basis.

what_you_do: Work a paid job in a career field you pick. You also take related classes. When you finish, you earn a state Certificate of Occupational Proficiency.
deadline_text: The 2025-26 DWD calendar lists March 1, 2026 as the YA enrollment deadline for grant funding. 2026-27 student deadlines are not posted there. Ask your regional coordinator.

what_you_do: Join FFA through your school's agriculture program. FFA members build leadership and career skills and can go to events like the state convention.
deadline_text: No membership deadline is posted.

what_you_do: Join a cadet squadron near you. The Wisconsin Wing site lists programs like summer encampment, a wing conference and Legislative Day. Activity details are not on the pages read.
deadline_text: No deadline. Join any time.

what_you_do: Join a delegation and take on a role in a student model government. Write bills, argue court cases or produce media. Or run for Youth Governor. Then meet at Model Government in Madison.
deadline_text: 2026-27: Judicial, Media and Senate registration closes November 18, 2026. Assembly registration closes December 9, 2026. Pre-Gov is January 30, 2027. Model Government is March 5 to 7, 2027.

what_you_do: You can take free college classes as a high school student. Some are at partner high schools. Eleven schools offer them, including Woodland, Pioneer and Winters. Others are online or on campus.
deadline_text: Rolling by term.

what_you_do: Teens earn school community service credit. They serve seniors in Woodland.
deadline_text: No dates on the Teen Programs page.

what_you_do: Help with library tasks at scheduled events, like prepping crafts, pulling materials and cleaning. Or write a book review and get one hour of service for each review.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register for each volunteering event on the volunteering calendar. Reviews can be submitted once a month.

what_you_do: You can get career advising and job readiness workshops. You can get paid work experience. You can also connect with employers in Santa Clara County.
deadline_text: Enrollment is open year-round.

what_you_do: Free career help for young adults. It includes one-on-one counseling, resume and interview training, and job placement. You can take job shadows and company tours. You can get paid work at a local worksite. You may get money for training or school.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the page.

what_you_do: This is free help for Atlanta youth all year. You get paid work experience and internships. You get job readiness workshops. You get GED or high school support. You can take short training that leads to credentials.
deadline_text: Year-round, first come first served. After the online orientation you have 30 days to submit all documents or your application may be closed.

what_you_do: Career planning, help finishing high school or a GED, skills training and a paid work experience placement, with a mentor and job placement help. Free.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed.

what_you_do: This is year-round job readiness training. It includes GED and high school diploma help. You can get paid work experience and transportation help. You also get occupational skills training. It is for Fulton County youth.
deadline_text: Year-round. No application dates are posted.

what_you_do: Apply and interview for a paid summer internship with a local employer. The Home Run team gives work readiness training and the city pays you.
deadline_text: The 2026 Internship Calendar is an image on the page (not readable here). 2027 dates not posted yet.

what_you_do: Spend one week on campus doing a hands-on research project led by Xavier faculty, with college readiness workshops. Choose a day camp or a residential stay.
deadline_text: The page shows 2026 dates and prices under a 2027 title. The Summer Programs page says 2027 programs are being finalized and that 2027 scholarship applications are open.

what_you_do: You pick a career interest. Yolo County Office of Education staff match you with a vetted mentor. The mentor works at a business, agency or nonprofit. You complete about 60 hours of hands-on learning.
deadline_text: Rolling; no posted deadline.

what_you_do: You can get paid job training and work placements in Oakland. Summer programs include Oakland Summer Rising, Team Oakland and Career Try-Out. There are also afterschool jobs.
deadline_text: No closing dates posted. YEP lists an Afterschool Job Application and a Young Adult Program Application 2026.

what_you_do: Join Leaders Club or Changemakers. In Leaders Club, teens lead projects, plan events, do service projects, and connect with mentors. It can include travel to conferences. In Changemakers, teens work on causes they care about, with advocacy and public speaking.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Register on the Y site or at your local branch.

what_you_do: You can help at YMCA special events at age 14 and up. Events include golf tournaments and 5K races. At 16 and up, you can take an ongoing role. Roles include tutor, sports volunteer and Kids Zone helper.
deadline_text: No dates listed. Special-event volunteering is seasonal, so the page says to stay tuned.

what_you_do: Teens 14 and older build job skills. They get job readiness training. They can earn certifications. They may get paid internships and job placements. What is offered varies by YMCA branch.
deadline_text: Not stated on the page.

what_you_do: Teens mentor students during five-day outdoor science school sessions in the redwoods. They guide activities. They help keep camp safe and fun. Leaders get a full day of training before students arrive.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 school year open in August and close in the middle of May. The exact closing date is not stated.

what_you_do: This is a year-long leadership and community service club for teens. It meets at local YMCA branches. Members get leadership training. They volunteer with Y programs.
deadline_text: No registration deadline stated. Clubs start in early fall; A.E. Finley YMCA held interest meetings September 15 and 16, 2026.

what_you_do: Teens meet in small groups. They explore education and career options. They do community service. They take college and industry tours. High school students tour universities each spring break.
deadline_text: No application or registration deadline stated. College tour registration opens in early 2027.

what_you_do: You go to weekly local meetings. At in-person conferences in November and February, you act as a lawmaker, lawyer or judge.
deadline_text: Sign-up dates are not stated on the page. A conference is planned for November, so ask now.

what_you_do: Join a community 4-H club. You do hands-on projects in animals, agriculture, arts and science. You can take part in events and leadership roles.
deadline_text: 2026-2027 enrollment fee posted ($80). No closing date stated; join through a local club.

what_you_do: You can get paid work experience with a local employer. You can also get help with job searches, resumes and interviews. You can get help with school or training options.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the page. Contact the Workforce Development Program Manager to check eligibility and enrollment.

what_you_do: You help library staff at a Yolo County Library branch. Opportunities differ by branch.
deadline_text: No deadline. Applications are accepted at branches.

what_you_do: Help the food bank pack food and work at distributions. Volunteers ages 12 to 17 sign a youth waiver with a parent signature.
deadline_text: Sign up for open shifts any time.

what_you_do: You can take part in service projects. You can join a peer mental health leadership program. There are school programs and a service award. This nonprofit runs them.
deadline_text: Ongoing. Service Award cycles run in four windows; the current one is Fall 2026, Sep 1 to Nov 30, 2026.

what_you_do: Get free job coaching, workforce readiness training and job placement. A Paid Work Experience is a 10 week job that is part work and part structured learning, with a chance to be hired for good.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Sign up any time using the interest form.

what_you_do: You can join a youth media group. You learn journalism, audio storytelling and digital content. Editors are your mentors. You keep control of your own stories.
deadline_text: No dates posted. Youth Radio paused in 2024 and says it is back in 2026.

what_you_do: You can get arts training and paid jobs if you are a low-income or homeless young person.
deadline_text: Not posted. The home page FAQ says YSA is not actively accepting applications.

what_you_do: You can get job readiness training. You can also get paid summer jobs or internships in East Oakland. Career and education services are open all year.
deadline_text: No dates posted on the site. Contact YU in spring for the next summer.

what_you_do: You can get free media training in classrooms and afterschool clubs. Advanced students can join a pre-apprentice program and paid fee-for-service projects at YouthBeat PRO.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Use the Apply link on the site.

what_you_do: Apply for a $2,000 scholarship. It goes to one high school senior who shows leadership and will go on to higher education. The award honors young people who lead with courage, fairness and service.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. The 2026 winner was to be announced at the Leader Luncheon on May 14, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted yet.

what_you_do: A free 12-week program with workshops, one-to-one support and a community project. You set goals and get real experience through volunteering, entry-level work or going back to school.
deadline_text: Registration is ongoing. Virtual cohorts start Sep 28, Oct 13 and Oct 19, 2026. Port Coquitlam Oct 26, 2026. Prince George Jan 4, 2027. Langley and Kelowna Jan 11, 2027.

what_you_do: Serve at the Zoo for a full program year in areas like habitat interpretation, public events, conservation projects, Safari Camp and animal nutrition. Training week is required.
deadline_text: Applications open 9 a.m. Jan 1 and close 5 p.m. Jan 31 (the page prints no year; it is for the June 2027 program year, so Jan 2027). A free Program Preview is Nov 14, 10 a.m. to noon, with registration.

what_you_do: You help real researchers. You classify images, audio and text. There are hundreds of online projects.
deadline_text: Always open.
